title: Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Rehan'Z Creator Network (RCN) is an emerging influencer marketing agency that connects brands with high-performing content creators to drive digital growth. The company specializes in micro-influencer campaigns designed to deliver authentic engagement and measurable results. Applicants joining RCN will be part of a growing team shaping the next generation of digital marketing.

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Editorial, Thought Leadership & Corporate Communications
description:
Job Description

Manager / Senior Manager – Editorial, Thought Leadership & Corporate Communications

**NK Realtors | Kolkata | 5–6+ Years**

Role Summary

We are
**not looking for a conventional content writer, Canva expert, or someone who can produce 15 Instagram posts a week.**

We are looking for someone who can
**think, research, interview and write**
—someone with excellent English, strong editorial judgement and the ability to simplify complex subjects into compelling narratives.

For example:

**Instead of:**

“Kolkata’s residential market is witnessing increasing demand for premium housing.”

**We want:**

“Kolkata’s premium housing market isn’t growing because buyers suddenly have more money. It is growing because a new generation of buyers is becoming far more deliberate about where—and how—they choose to live.”

Key Requirements

* Excellent English and strong writing skills
* Strong editorial judgement
* Ability to simplify complex subjects
* Curiosity about
  **business, economics, real estate and society**
* Ability to interview senior executives
* Strong thought-leadership writing skills
* Experience writing
  **Op-Eds, speeches, LinkedIn content, research reports, presentations and corporate narratives**
* Someone who understands
  **journalists—not just media coverage**
* Ability to understand
  **why a story needs to be carried**
  , rather than focusing only on the number of media insertions
* Strong journalist relationships with
  **Economic Times, Business Standard, Financial Express, TOI, ABP Group, real estate publications, relevant podcasts/newsletters and TV/business channels**
  will be preferred

Preferred Background / Industry

We would
**prefer someone from a Business Journalism / Financial Journalism / Editorial background rather than conventional Corporate Communications.**

Relevant experience from
**business media, financial publications, real estate publications, newsrooms, editorial platforms, business television, podcasts/newsletters or leading media houses**
will be preferred.

Experience

**5–6+ years of relevant experience**
, with a strong portfolio demonstrating original thinking and writing.

**The ideal candidate is a thinker and writer first—not a content producer.**

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:
**Description**
As a Manager, Human-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Leading essential change management and enablement initiatives, you will establish the groundwork for successful and enduring change adoption, using AI-enabled delivery practices. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Change Leadership:**

* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.

**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**

* Proactively foster high-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.

**Key Change Management Initiatives**

* Lead critical change management and enablement activities to facilitate successful and sustained change adoption.
* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.

**Oversight And Mentoring**

* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.
* Background in technology or digital transformation projects, showcasing advanced problem-solving abilities and analytical acumen.
* Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience in change management, with a strong foundation in Instructional Design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.

**Overview**
The Manager, Human-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities. If you are a seasoned Change Management Professional with a track record of success in guiding organizations through complex technology implementations, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of driving impactful and sustainable change.

title: PHD Graduate Student
company: John C. Martin Center for Liver Research and Innovations (JCMLRI)
description:
**Company Description**
John C. Martin Center for Liver Research and Innovations (JCMLRI) is a research institution dedicated to innovative basic, clinical, and public-health studies with a primary focus on liver diseases and broader aspects of human health and disease. Established in 2018, JCMLRI is located in Sonarpur, approximately 20 km from Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The center operates within the premises of the Indian Institute of Liver Diseases and Digestive Sciences (IILDS), a treatment, education, and research institute in gastroenterology and liver diseases. JCMLRI offers an integrated environment where clinical care, education, and research intersect, providing graduate students with exposure to cutting-edge liver and digestive disease research. The institution encourages collaborative, multidisciplinary work and aims to translate research findings into meaningful improvements in population health.
  
**Role Description**
The PhD Graduate Student at JCMLRI will participate in full-time, on-site research activities based in Kolkata, focusing on liver diseases and related areas of human health. Daily responsibilities include designing and conducting experiments, collecting and analyzing data, and maintaining accurate laboratory records. The role involves reviewing scientific literature, contributing to research proposals, and preparing manuscripts, presentations, and reports for conferences and peer-reviewed journals. The student will collaborate with faculty, clinicians, and other researchers, attend seminars and lab meetings, and engage in academic discussions to refine research questions and methodologies. The position also includes adherence to ethical and safety standards in laboratory and clinical research, and potential involvement in public-health or translational projects aligned with JCMLRI’s mission.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in biomedical sciences (e.g., physiology, molecular biology, biochemistry, public health, or related disciplines) relevant to liver and digestive disease research.
* Demonstrated research skills, including experimental design, data collection, statistical analysis, and scientific documentation.
* Proficiency in laboratory techniques appropriate to the chosen research area (such as cell culture, molecular assays, imaging, or clinical data handling), with attention to safety and quality control.
* Effective scientific communication skills, including the ability to write research articles, theses, and reports, and present findings to academic and clinical audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, manage time and projects independently, and adapt to a fast-paced research environment.
* Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field and eligibility for PhD enrollment as per institutional and regulatory requirements.
* Interest in liver diseases, gastroenterology, or public-health research; prior experience in these domains is an advantage.
* Commitment to ethical research practices, continuous learning, and professional development within an academic research setting.

**About SwitchON Foundation & Greenovation Accelerator**

SwitchON Foundation (est. 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

The
**Greenovation Accelerator**
is our flagship platform for climate-focused startups, SMEs, FPOs, and FPCs working across agriculture, circularity, clean energy, resilience, and other areas of climate action. Through challenge programs, bootcamps, capacity building, mentorship, market linkages, and connections to capital, Greenovation helps promising organizations strengthen their business foundations and progress toward investment readiness and scale.

**Position Overview**

The
**Greenovation Accelerator Co-Lead**
will lead the end-to-end operational execution, capacity building, and ecosystem coordination for SwitchON’s flagship accelerator programs. Based in Kolkata or Bangalore (Hybrid), this role requires strong program management, field execution, deal flow sourcing, and startup engagement capabilities.

* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

description:
**Project Role :**
Technology Support Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**

15 years full time education

CL-10
  
  
Role: Azure Kubernetes Specialist
  
  
Total experience: 6+ years of progressive experience in IT
  
  
Relevant experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in managing Azure Kubernetes Platform.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly proficient Azure Cloud Container & Platform Engineer (5–8 years of experience) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for architecting, deploying, and maintaining secure, scalable, and production-grade containerized platforms on Azure. You will focus on the end-to-end lifecycle of containerized workloads, spanning from development to deployment across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, and Azure App Service (Container Runtime), all underpinned by robust Azure DevOps CI/CD strategies.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Design, build, and maintain Azure Kubernetes, Container, Container Instances, Azure Web App Container Runtime using Bicep, ARM, Terraforom Automate the provisioning of key components including Key Vault (secrets/certificates), User Assigned Managed Identities (UAMI), Storage Accounts, and comprehensive monitoring workspaces.
  
  
Kubernetes Resource Management (AKS): Architect, deploy, and manage Kubernetes resources following GitOps best practices. This includes managing Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, and implementing Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA) and Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) to ensure workload reliability.
  
  
Container Runtime & App Service Management: Configure and optimize the execution environment for containerized web applications within Azure App Service and Azure Container Apps, ensuring seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Image Management & Registry (ACR): Oversee Azure Container Registry (ACR) lifecycles, including geo-replication, image lifecycle policies, and secure image scanning.
  
  
Networking & Traffic Management: Deploy and manage Ingress controllers (NGINX), configure private endpoints, and implement robust traffic routing and load balancing strategies for both AKS and App Service containers.
  
  
Security, Governance & Compliance: Enforce enterprise security standards using Azure RBAC, Workload Identities, and network segmentation (NSGs/Firewalls). Manage secret rotation via Key Vault + CSI driver integration.
  
  
Observability: Configure full-stack monitoring using Azure Monitor for Containers, Application Insights, and Prometheus/Grafana to build real-time dashboards for infrastructure and application health.
  
  
AKS Upgrades: Handling AKS Cluster and Node upgrades seamlessly without impact to business operations.
  
  
Platform Operations: Support containerized application lifecycles using Kubernetes architect and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and drive proactive monitoring and rapid troubleshooting of cluster-wide issues.
  
  
Security & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce enterprise-grade security via RBAC, complex network policies, and encryption ensure strict adherence to industry-specific compliance frameworks such as RBI and PCI DSS.
  
  
Strategic Leadership: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Azure Kubernetes, Container mentoring engineering teams and championing the adoption of GitOps practices.
  
  
**Requirements & Qualifications**
Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, with deep expertise in Azure Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  
  
Technical Expertise:
  
  

* Containers: Expert knowledge of Docker, image optimization, and container runtime environments (AKS, Azure Container Apps, App Service).
* Orchestration: Deep understanding of Kubernetes resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows.
* IaC: Advanced proficiency in Bicep, ARM template, Terraform
* Cloud Foundation: Strong knowledge of Azure Networking (VNets/NSGs), Storage, and Identity (UAMI/Workload Identity).
* DevOps: Proven experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, service connections, and artifact repositories.

Certification Required:
  
  

* Cloud: Microsoft Certified: AZ-305, AZ-400
* Platform: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).

Professional Attributes: Excellent troubleshooting skills across Linux, Kubernetes, and Azure strong commitment to standardization, security-first design, and audit compliance.
  
  
Professional Experience/Attribute
  
  
Strong familiarity with Azure cloud services with deep and comprehensive knowledge of DNS, Networking.
  
  
Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data.
  
  
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working with cross-functional teams.
  
  
Adept at defining and tracking KPIs for performance improvement.
  
  
Prior experience in monitoring and analyzing cloud cost trends.
  
  
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to create and maintain documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Highly self-motivated individuals with the ability to identify areas of focus and tackle new challenges.

Adaptability to work in a dynamic international environment.

Promotes open sharing of views and encourages collaboration.

Commitment to standardization and simplification in all work aspects.

**Microsoft 365 (M365) Specialist**
**Reports To: Director, Global IT Support & Collaboration Services**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft 365 Specialist to manage, optimize, and support our global Microsoft 365 environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of core collaboration and productivity platforms, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and related services across a geographically distributed organization.
  
  
The M365 Specialist will serve as a technical subject matter expert, supporting end users across multiple regions, driving platform governance, and implementing best practices to enhance collaboration, security, and operational efficiency at a global scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Administration & Operations**

* Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Manage user accounts, licenses, roles, and permissions through Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Admin Center
* Monitor service health, performance, and availability; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests
* Perform tenant-level configuration, updates, and feature deployments

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, and data protection policies
* Support compliance initiatives (eDiscovery, retention policies, audit logs, DLP)
* Monitor and respond to security alerts and vulnerabilities within the M365 environment
* Ensure adherence to organizational and regulatory security standards

**End User Support & Enablement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for Microsoft 365-related issues and escalations
* Deliver user training, documentation, and knowledge base content to drive adoption
* Act as an escalation point for complex collaboration, messaging, and identity-related issues

**Engineering, Projects & Optimization**

* Lead or support migrations to/from Microsoft 365 (email, file shares, tenant consolidation)
* Implement governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage
* Integrate M365 with enterprise systems and third-party applications
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, and platform efficiency

**Automation & Documentation**

* Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell or native M365 tools
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards for usage, health, and compliance

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft 365 administration and support experience
* Strong expertise in:
* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive for Business
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and identity/access management
* Proven experience implementing Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps)
* Hybrid environments (Azure AD Connect, on-prem AD integration)
* Familiarity with governance frameworks, ITIL processes
* Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-102, MS-900, MS-700, AZ-104)
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager

**Key Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Continuous learning mindset to stay current with M365 roadmap and emerging capabilities
* Focus on security, compliance, and operational excellence

**Work arrangements**

* Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
* Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

**Paid time off**

* Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.
* Paid volunteer time: take up to 4 days annually to give your time to a charitable organization of your choice

**Your money**

* My Benefit platform/Multisport card: enjoy the benefit cafeteria system and use popular sport card
* Tax deduction: take the opportunity to claim deductible costs, reducing your income tax
* Employee Capital Plans: profit from long-term saving scheme co-financed by Sabre and the State Treasury
* Baby Bonus: benefit from one-time allowance on childbirth or adoption

**Health and wellness**

* Luxmed VIP medical coverage: take care of yourself and your family with the extensive medical package with a broad range of additional services
* Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
* Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
* Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health
* Life insurance: sign up for free, high coverage life insurance program

**Career development**

* Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
* Certification and tuition reimbursement
* Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

**And more**

* Fun & Relax zone in modern office: enjoy electronic tables to work, foosball, ping pong, pool table, swings, massage chairs and terraces to admire a panoramic view of Kraków. We have parents’ rooms as well
* No dress code

* Attractive Referral Bonus

Operate on a bank-wide basis, collaborating closely with GRR peers and providing RR technical advice and guidance to support their relationship management responsibilities.

Support GRR Business & Functions teams in explaining, in non-technical terms, the impact of issues, events and top or emerging risks that may require changes to controls, resources or business operations to remain within risk appetite.

 This hybrid position is based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of in\-office collaboration and work\-from\-home flexibility. Day\-to\-day tasks include planning and producing web and social media content, creative ads, developing content strategies aligned with D2C growth objectives, and coordinating campaigns across platforms. The role involves engaging with audiences, analyzing performance metrics, optimizing messaging, and maintaining a consistent brand voice. The executive will work closely with marketing, design, and product teams to support launches, promotions, shoots, and ongoing community\-building efforts. You will work directly with the founder to grow Manaaf's digital presence, manage and scale performance marketing across Meta and Instagram, create and edit content that converts, and contribute to brand strategy decisions that shape how Manaaf shows up in the world.
 



 This is not a single function role. This is a growth role.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Performance Marketing —



 Plan, execute, and optimise Meta and Instagram ad campaigns independently. Manage daily budgets, analyse CPM, CPC, CTR, ROAS, and CAC. Make data driven decisions on scaling and pausing ad sets. Build and manage retargeting audiences and lookalike campaigns. Report weekly on campaign performance with clear recommendations.
 


* Content Creation and Editing alongside the editing member in charge—



 Create and edit Instagram Reels, static posts, Stories, and UGC content that is on\-brand and built to convert. Understand hook theory, retention editing, and caption copywriting. Assist in indoor and outdoor shoots. Bring creative ideas independently without waiting to be briefed on every piece.
 


* Brand Strategy and Social Media Growth —



 Manage Manaaf's Instagram and other social media platforms day to day. Build organic follower growth through community engagement, collaboration outreach, and content strategy. Maintain consistent brand voice, aesthetic, and identity across every platform. Identify collaboration and partnership opportunities with micro creators and founders in the modest fashion and lifestyle space.
 


* Website and Ecommerce Support —



 Work within Shopify to update product pages, implement discount codes, monitor website analytics, and identify conversion drop\-off points. Coordinate with email marketing flows and abandoned cart sequences.
 


* Analytics and Reporting —



 Pull weekly reports from Meta Ads Manager, Instagram Insights, and Shopify Analytics. Identify trends, opportunities, and problems early. Present findings clearly to the founder with actionable recommendations.
 



  





**Skills Required** 



* Has independently managed Meta Ads Manager campaigns for a D2C brand — not assisted, not watched. Actually managed. Can show real campaign data and results.
* Proficient in CapCut at minimum. Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro preferred.
* Strong understanding of Instagram algorithm, content performance, organic growth strategies, and what makes Reels perform in 2024 and beyond.
* Comfortable with Shopify — product page updates, analytics, discount code management, basic store operations.
* Basic graphic design skills — Canva at minimum. Adobe Express or Photoshop preferred.
* Strong written communication for captions, ad copy, and brand messaging.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver without hand\-holding.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience working with a D2C brand — agency experience alone will not be considered.
* Portfolio of edited Reels and ad creatives with performance data is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.
* Has managed a Meta Ads campaign from setup to optimisation independently — must be able to demonstrate this with screenshots or data.
* Based in Kolkata or able to commute for shoots and in\-person work sessions regularly.
* Experience in fashion, modest wear, lifestyle, or women\-focused D2C is a strong advantage.



  





**Who Should Not Apply** 



* Freshers with zero brand experience looking for their first internship.
* Candidates who have only worked at agencies and have never been directly responsible for a brand's growth.
* People who need detailed briefs for every task and cannot work with autonomy.
* Anyone who cannot show real campaign data and results from previous work.
* Candidates who are not genuinely interested in modest fashion, luxury brands, or women\-focused D2C — cultural alignment with Manaaf's identity matters.
* Anyone looking for a 9 to 5 execution role. This is a building role. Some weeks will demand more.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct access to the founder and real creative ownership from day one.
* The experience of building a premium D2C brand from its earliest stage — with full visibility into every decision.
* A role where your work directly impacts revenue — not just impressions.
* Flexible hybrid working with in\-person shoot days in Kolkata.
* Compensation depending on experience and demonstrated results. Performance incentive structure to be discussed.



  





**To Apply**

 Manaaf Growth Application —

**Share us on this email\- teammanaaf@gmail.com or community@bemanaaf.com**

***We are looking for someone who wants to help build it.***

title: Specialist
description:
Location \- Kolkata \-Metayb Office
   

  

 Work hours \- 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST
   

  

 Workdays \- Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience \- 5\+ years in accounting and finance operations
   

  

 Qualification \- B.Com / M.Com \+ CA Inter / CMA Inter
   

  

 Purpose of the role
   

  

 You will be the day\-to\-day owner of the client's books. You run the accounting cycle end to end — transactions, reconciliations, close, reporting packs and the rolling cash flow forecast — so that Manager — Finance, can focus on review, technical judgement, controls and the client relationship.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on execution role on a single client. You are accountable for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and audit\-ready documentation.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Accounting and bookkeeping operations
* Maintain the general ledger in QuickBooks Online on a timely and accurate basis.
* Process accounts payable end to end: vendor bill entry, coding, duplicate checks, vendor master maintenance and preparation of payment runs for approval.
* Process accounts receivable end to end: customer invoicing, cash application, collection follow\-up tracker and escalation of overdue accounts.
* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and resolve open and ageing reconciling items.
* Classify transactions correctly by account, division and class, and clear unclassified items before close.
* Maintain the document repository so that every material entry has supporting documentation attached and retrievable.
* Prepare balance sheet account schedules and supporting reconciliations for review.
* Monthly and year\-end close
* Execute the monthly close calendar and deliver each step on the agreed date.
* Prepare recurring journals, accruals, prepaid amortisation, deferrals and other period\-end entries.
* Prepare month\-on\-month variance data and flag unusual movements before review.
* Draft the monthly Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.
* Prepare year\-end schedules and the supporting information pack for the client's external CPA.
* Keep books organised and review\-ready for tax, lender, investor or other professional examination at any point in the year.
* Cash flow and treasury
* Maintain and update the rolling 13\-week cash flow forecast on a weekly cycle.
* Track cash inflows and collections, operating and vendor payments, and expected cash requirements.
* Report the daily or weekly bank position and flag near\-term cash gaps early.
* Maintain forecast\-to\-actual tracking so forecast accuracy improves over time.
* Division\-wise accounting and reporting
* Maintain the QuickBooks Online class and location structure that separates the two business divisions.
* Apply the agreed shared\-cost allocation methodology consistently each month.
* Produce division\-wise revenue, direct and operating cost, profitability and cash generation reporting.
* Keep the division mapping clean as new accounts, customers and vendors are added.
* Management reporting
* Compile the monthly reporting pack: P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, AR ageing, AP ageing and division\-wise performance.
* Prepare the supporting analysis and data that sits behind the commentary.
* Respond to routine information requests from the client within the agreed turnaround.
* Process and controls
* Operate the agreed finance controls over expenses, payments, billing, collections and record keeping, and retain the evidence.
* Draft and keep current the standard operating procedures and process notes for every task you run.
* Identify manual or error\-prone steps and propose automation or simplification.
* Payroll and tax coordination
* Post and reconcile payroll journals from the client's payroll processor.
* Prepare the accounting information and schedules required by the client's CPA, payroll processor and other external professionals.
* Coordinate on queries and follow\-ups under the Manager's direction.


**Must\-have Qualifications And Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on accounting and finance operations experience.
* B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA Inter or CMA Inter.
* Demonstrated experience running a full monthly close cycle independently — not just one part of it.
* Working knowledge of US accounting practice and US GAAP fundamentals, gained through a US client, US shared services centre, or a KPO or outsourced accounting firm serving US clients.
* Practical, current working experience on QuickBooks Online.
* Strong Excel: pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFS, reconciliation workbooks, and building a forecast model that someone else can follow.
* Proven ownership of both AP and AR cycles, and of bank and credit card reconciliations.
* Clear written and spoken English, sufficient for direct email and call contact with a US client.
* Comfortable working the 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST shift from the Kolkata office.


**Preferred**
* Experience with class, location or department\-level accounting — segment, division or cost\-centre reporting.
* Experience coordinating with an external CPA, auditor or lender.
* Familiarity with tools around QuickBooks: Bill.com, ADP or similar.
* Any automation exposure — advanced Excel, Power Query, or workflow tools.

title: Client Servicing Executive
description:
You like people. You like ideas. You like getting things done.
 
 We’re looking for a
 **Client Servicing / Account Executive** 
 who can sit between a client brief and a great piece of work and make sure neither gets lost in translation.
 



 Someone who can take a “Can we make this bigger?” call at 6 PM, turn it into an actual brief, get the creative team moving, keep the client in the loop and somehow still remember that the artwork is due tomorrow morning.
 



 Basically,
 **you make the agency work.** 



 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
 
**Be the client’s go\-to person.** 




 Build relationships, understand their business and make sure they always know what’s happening.
 



**Turn briefs into briefs.** 




 Listen, question, clarify and translate client requirements into something the creative, design, digital and production teams can actually work with.
 



**Keep the wheels turning.** 




 Coordinate timelines, follow\-ups, feedback, approvals, meetings and deliverables without letting anything fall through the cracks.
 



**Know your client’s business.** 




 Don’t just know what they want. Understand
 *why* 
 they want it. Keep an eye on their industry, competition, audience and brand.
 



**Work with creative teams, not against them.** 




 You don’t need to be a designer or copywriter, but you should know a good idea when you see one and be able to sell it internally and externally.
 



**Present work with confidence.** 




 Because “the creative team made this” is not a presentation.
 



**Own the chaos.** 




 There will be last\-minute changes, impossible deadlines, contradictory feedback and the occasional “small change” that isn't actually small. Deal with it. Calmly.
 


 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 * **2–3 years of experience** 
 in advertising, creative agencies, digital agencies, marketing, brand communication, events or a related industry.
* Someone who is naturally
 **curious about brands, culture, people and ideas** 
 .
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Good organisational and project management skills.
* The ability to juggle multiple clients and projects without losing the plot.
* Someone who can confidently interact with clients and equally confidently challenge an idea when needed.
* Good presentation skills.
* A sharp eye for detail.
* Proficiency with everyday tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Google Workspace and email. Knowing your way around digital and social media is a definite plus.
* Most importantly,
 **a sense of ownership** 
 . We like people who don't wait to be told what needs doing.


 BONUS POINTS IF YOU...
 
 Have opinions about advertising.
 



 Know why some campaigns work and others don't.
 



 Can explain a complicated brief without making it sound complicated.
 



 Have a decent meme game.
 



 Can spot a typo from across the room.
 



 Or simply have the habit of asking,
 **“Okay, but what are we actually trying to achieve?”** 



 WHAT YOU’LL GET
 
 A chance to work across interesting brands, categories and formats.
 



 Exposure to the entire communication process, from the first brief to the final delivery.
 



 A fast\-moving agency environment where ideas matter, initiative is appreciated and no two days are exactly alike.
 



 And colleagues who understand that
 **good work is serious business. Taking ourselves too seriously isn't.** 



 THE IMPORTANT BITS
 
**Role:** 
 Client Servicing / Account Executive
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Industry:** 
 Advertising / Marketing / Communications
 



 If you think you can be the person who keeps clients happy, teams moving and ideas getting better,
 **we should talk.** 




  




* ﻿
 
 Company Description Versus Communications is a through\-the\-line communications agency that transforms brand narratives into emotional experiences that engage audiences and drive results. The agency operates across versusCommunications, versusEVENTS, versusFILMS, and versusSOCIAL, offering end\-to\-end brand solutions. Headquartered in Kolkata with offices in Delhi and Mumbai and representation in Bengaluru, Versus partners with leading organizations such as Tata Steel, ITC, Tata Motors, UNICEF, Apollo Hospitals, and others. The team believes that strong brands are not only seen and heard but deeply felt, creating meaningful connections between organizations and their audiences.

* Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and documentation, ensuring they are up\-to\-date and compliant with industry standards.
* Conduct regular access reviews and audits to identify and mitigate potential security risks.

* Drive identity governance initiatives and enhance role\-based access control (RBAC) models.
* Recommend and implement improvements to IAM processes and the overall Okta environment.
* Stay informed about Okta updates, new features, and IAM industry trends to drive innovation within the organization.
* Develop and maintain documentation for processes, workflows, and configurations.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, standards, and IAM best practices.
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to end\-users and stakeholders regarding identity management processes.

**Preferred Skills:**

description:

**EY\- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role** 
 :
 **GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety \& Reliability)**
**Position Details**
 As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG\-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain\-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands\-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).


**Additional skills requirements:**
* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self\-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self\-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Purpose**
 :
 



  





 To support the sourcing head in executing procurement strategies for E\-waste scrap from Eastern India. Assist in vendor development, contract administration, compliance tracking, and data reporting. Contribute to building a robust supply chain and implementing procurement technologies. Facilitating sourcing of raw materials as per assigned targets. The role will involve travelling and meeting OEMS, scrap vendors and recyclers.
 



  





**Job Context:**




  





 The role supports the development of India’s first integrated facility for processing e waste and copper scrap, with a planned feed capacity of 80 KTPA. E waste—particularly printed circuit boards (PCBs)—contains significantly higher precious metal content compared to conventional copper concentrate, making it a high value and high profit feedstock.
 



  





 The proposed facility will source 30 KTPA of e waste, primarily PCBs. However, nearly 90% of this material is currently handled by the unorganized sector. The role is responsible for building a compliant, structured supply chain in Eastern India, converting informal sourcing into a formal ecosystem aligned with regulatory and commercial requirements.
 



  





 Key elements of the role include developing collection models, ensuring tax and E waste compliance across suppliers, and establishing systems to manage pricing volatility. The role also involves exploring local sourcing opportunities for PCB scrap, developing supplier contracts, generating market intelligence, and supporting IT systems and internal controls.
 



  





**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
 
 :**

 Vendor relationship

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers across formal and informal sectors.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard new suppliers in line with sourcing requirements.
* Ensure timely documentation, verification, and activation of suppliers.
* Act as the primary point of contact to resolve supplier issues and improve engagement.



  





**2\.

* Ensure supplier compliance with taxation laws, statutory requirements, and E\-waste regulations.
* Periodically review supplier compliance status and flag risks proactively.
* Support audits and regulatory checks related to supplier governance



  





**3\.
 
 Process Improvement, Systems \& Internal Controls**
 \-
 


* Support the design, implementation, and improvement of supplier management systems and SOPs.
* Assist in strengthening internal controls to reduce operational and compliance risks.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Operations) to streamline workflows.
* Identify gaps and recommend process enhancements for efficiency and scalability.

**5\.
 
 Stakeholder Coordination \& Reporting
 
 \-**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
* **Role:**



 Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Gemini Enterprise, Agentic AI, and Multi\-Agent Systems
 



 Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade Multi\-Agent Systems (MAS) and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise
* Identify need for Pro Code Vs No Code design based on customer’s problem statement and data sources
* Design Deployand custom agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine and integrate with Gemini Enterprise
* Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem (Docs, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery.
* Architect scalable short\-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long\-term memory architectures across multi\-agent interactions.
* Implement end\-to\-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, Google Cloud services, and 3rd\-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / M365, Salesforce, Atlassian) using IAM, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and service identities.
* Enforce fine\-grained Access Control Lists (ACLs), user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries.
* Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and root cause analysis (RCA).
* Architect Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points.
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations.
* Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain\-of\-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan\-and\-Solve, and Self\-Reflection to enhance agent reliability.
* Establish quantitative evaluation frameworks to measure agent trajectories, tool invocation precision/recall, and reasoning faithfulness.
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments.



 Must\-Have Skills
 


* Core Engineering \& Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python with production\-level software engineering practices, along with deep, hands\-on experience building multi\-agent systems using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) or comparable agentic frameworks.
* Gemini \& Workspace Ecosystem: Solid hands\-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the broader Google Workspace Ecosystem (APIs, Add\-ons, Drive/Docs connectors).
* Memory \& State Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in managing agent session state, short\-term context caching, and durable long\-term memory backends (vector databases, relational/NoSQL session stores).
* Third Party Tools: Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third\-party platforms (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, DocuSign, MS Office Suite, Sharepoint, JIRA) with Gemini Enterprise.
* Auth \& Security: Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (IAM, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, Service Accounts, Workload Identity Federation) across Google Cloud and 3rd\-party SaaS platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, Atlassian).
* ACLs \& Permissions: Deep working knowledge of enterprise Access Control Lists (ACLs), identity federation, permission trimming, and role\-based access control (RBAC) across heterogeneous data sources.
* Developer Tooling: Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing.
* CI/CD \& DevOps: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation.
* Evaluation \& Debugging: Practical knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions.
* Client Collaboration: Strong technical communication, consulting acumen, and client\-facing collaboration skills within an Agile environment.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**EternUp is building the digital twin for human life — an AI operating system that connects your time, work, relationships, health, knowledge and finances into one continuously evolving model of you. Powered by Continuo, our personal context layer, EternUp understands not just what you ask for, but what's happening and what should happen next — then acts on it through Aeon, an AI chief of staff that coordinates specialized agents across your calendar, tasks, health, and logistics. We're the human side of a two\-sided platform: the same digital\-twin technology powers Twinamics for businesses. This is a new category, not a calendar app or a wellness tracker — and we're building the infrastructure for it from the ground up.** 




  





**Role Description** 




**As a Founding Engineer at EternUp, you'll design, build, and scale the core systems behind our digital twin: the context layer that ingests and models a person's life, the agent runtime that lets Aeon act safely on their behalf, and the day\-design and task systems users touch every day. You'll work across a modern stack (Next.js/React, Postgres, agentic AI orchestration) and collaborate directly with the founders to turn product and architectural decisions into shipped, tested code. Day to day, this means high\-quality backend and full\-stack work, sound engineering judgment on what an autonomous agent should and shouldn't be allowed to do, and end\-to\-end ownership of features from spec to production. This is a full\-time hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of on\-site collaboration and flexible work\-from\-home days.** 




  





**Qualifications** 



* Full\-stack engineering: strong TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js on the frontend, Node/Postgres on the backend — able to build and ship a feature end\-to\-end alone
* GUI/frontend craft: can build clean, responsive interfaces from scratch and implement a design system precisely (spacing, typography, states) — not just plug in a component library
* Agentic systems, built not bolted on: has built agent loops, tool\-calling, or orchestration logic from open\-source frameworks or from scratch (LangGraph, CrewAI, custom loops) — not just prompting a hosted API and calling it done
* Actuator/automation layer: experience building systems that take real\-world actions on a user's behalf — action registries, permission gating, execution logs — using self\-hosted or open\-source tooling (e.g., browser automation via Playwright/CDP, not a paid automation SaaS)
* Open\-source\-first instinct: default to self\-hosting and open\-source stacks (Postgres, open LLMs where viable, open queues/workers, open auth) over proprietary APIs and managed SaaS wherever it's practical
* CI/CD and infra: can set up and maintain build/test/deploy pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), containerization (Docker), and basic cloud infra without hand\-holding
* Systems/backend depth: comfortable with databases, auth, queues, and API design — not just frontend\-adjacent scripting
* Startup ownership: writes production\-quality code fast, debugs down to root cause, and takes a feature from idea to deployed without needing a spec for every detail

description:

 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. **The Role**
***As a Mechanical Engineer with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Experience in phases of engineering e.g., Concept, Basic and Detail Engineering phases.
* Experience in core areas of Mechanical discipline e.g. preparing equipment layouts, technical specifications, datasheets, Material Requisitions, knowledge of national, international codes and standards, Technical Bid Analysis, Vendor data review, 3D Model Reviews.
* Capable to handle large or medium scale project and responsible for technical and resources planning as well as keep tab on budget, quality and schedule.
* In depth knowledge and capable for preparation of Technical Specification, Tender Bid Evaluation and review of Vendor drawings / document independently for Mineral Beneficiation Equipment like, Crusher, Sizer, Screen, Mills, Cyclone, Slurry Pumps, Floatation Cell, Thickener, Filter Press etc. including Material Handling Equipment.
* Exposure of Conveyor Calculation (preferably in various internationally established software), Chute Design, Material Flow analysis.
* Experience in working with designers / draftsman for Plant Layout and Plot Plan, General Arrangement drawings etc.
* Capable for reviewing 3D model in various 3D review software platform.
* Orientation to working in workshare environments with Lead office.
* Understanding of Project requirements like productivity/ schedule workhour control etc.
* Capable of interacting with all stakeholders including Inter discipline, client and vendors.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Good communication and presentation skills, verbal and written to communicate with client and lead offices.
* Support proposal engineering.
* Should be open for short travel and deputation to sites / lead offices where required.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Graduate Mech engineer with 10\+ years of Engineering exposure in the Mechanical Department of a consultancy organization. Experience range can be flexible for deserving candidate.

* Worked as Lead Mech Engineer in projects for minimum 10 years over and above managing a Mech team.
* Experience in Material Handling, Equipment associated with Mining, Minerals and Metals (MMM) industry.

We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
It's about Being What's next.
 **What's in it for you?**

 The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  


 Making an impact.
 **What will you do?**

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof\-of\-concept steps and practical remediation actions
* You will need to retest fixes, confirm closure and record residual risk or exceptions

 Winning in your role.

* And also, at least six months of hands\-on web, API or mobile security testing, including manual testing and scanner validation
* Must is knowledge with OWASP, WSTG, MAS, CWE and CVSS, Web, API and mobile black\-box/grey\-box testing

* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices

title: Mechanical Draf
description:
**Company Description** 
 International Engineering Plant is a manufacturing and supply organization focused on a wide range of engineering equipment for diverse industrial applications. In addition to production, the company provides comprehensive design and installation services for its engineering products, supporting clients throughout the project lifecycle. As an ISO 9001 certified company, International Engineering Plant follows established quality management standards and strives for continuous improvement. Team members collaborate in a professional environment that values technical expertise, safety, and reliable customer service.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Mechanical Draft role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kolkata. The individual in this role prepares detailed mechanical drawings and schematics using computer\-aided design (CAD) software, based on engineering specifications and project requirements. This position requires careful attention to detail, strong technical communication, and the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional project teams.

* Strong foundation in Mechanical Engineering principles, with the ability to interpret technical specifications and engineering drawings.
* Proficiency in Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) tools and software used for mechanical drafting and layout preparation.
* Experience or familiarity with Maintenance practices for mechanical systems and equipment.
* Knowledge of Inspection processes, quality checks, and documentation related to mechanical components.
* Exposure to Automotive or similar mechanical sectors, with understanding of mechanical assemblies and industrial standards.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering or Drafting from a recognized institution.
* Ability to work on\-site in Kolkata, follow safety protocols, and collaborate with engineering and production teams.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple drawings and project deadlines.

 Prior experience in a scaling D2C startup

 A brand built on authenticity and premium positioning, not mass production

description:

* Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for various software components and systems.

* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership abilities.

* Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting network infrastructure, including managed switches, VLANs, TCP/IP networking, routing, and related connectivity technologies in development, test, or production environments.
* Experience with object storage technologies, data lake house architectures, and modern data platforms used to support analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven solutions.
