title: FREELANCE OPPORTUNITY | ORGANIC REAL ESTATE GROWTH & LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (Kolkata Based) - Performance-based / Profit-sharing
description:
**LandConnect \& PropNexa \| Kolkata** 




**Freelance Organic Real Estate Lead Generation \& Community Marketing Specialist** 




**We are looking for an experienced, resourceful and result\-oriented freelance specialist** 
 to generate
 **genuine property buyers, sellers and high\-intent enquiries in Kolkata and surrounding markets** 
 through organic digital channels.
 



 This is
 **not a conventional social\-media management or posting job** 
 .
 



 We need someone who can
 **research where potential property customers are actively discussing their requirements, identify high\-intent opportunities, engage intelligently and convert them into qualified enquiries.** 




**🎯 PRIMARY OBJECTIVE** 




**Build a systematic organic customer\-acquisition engine** 
 for LandConnect \& PropNexa.
 



 The person should be capable of finding people looking for:
 


* Residential plots
* Flats/apartments
* Independent houses
* Land for construction
* Investment properties
* Resale properties
* Location\-specific properties
* Properties within particular budgets
* Landowners/sellers seeking genuine buyers



 The focus is:
 



**Demand Discovery → Organic Engagement → Trust Building → Lead Generation → Qualification → Conversion** 




**🌐 ORGANIC PLATFORMS** 




**Experience with some or all of the following:** 



* Reddit
* Quora
* Medium
* Facebook Groups \& Communities
* Facebook Marketplace/community discussions
* Instagram
* YouTube
* Google Search / Local Search
* Google Business Profile (GBP/GMB)
* Telegram
* Local property forums
* Other relevant niche communities



 The candidate should also be able to
 **discover new communities and platforms independently.** 




**🔎 DEMAND \& OPPORTUNITY DISCOVERY** 




**A major responsibility is finding existing property demand** 
 , rather than simply creating promotional content.
 



 Examples:
 



 “Looking for a 3\-katha plot near Joka.”
 



 “Need a flat in New Town under ₹1 crore.”
 



 “Looking for a plot near Sonarpur/Baruipur.”
 



 “I want to build my own house—where should I buy land?”
 



 “Looking for a resale flat in South Kolkata.”
 



 The candidate must identify such conversations, assess commercial relevance, understand the requirement and determine an appropriate organic response.
 



**🛠️ FREE / LOW\-COST TOOLS** 




**Preference for candidates who can achieve results through resourcefulness rather than expensive software** 
 .
 



 Useful tools may include:
 


* Reddit Enhancement Suite (RES)
* Q\-Stats
* Free SEO/keyword tools
* Content\-discovery tools
* Community\-analysis tools
* Browser extensions



 Experience with similar low\-cost tools is welcome.
 



**📍 GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE \& LOCAL SEO** 




**Experience with Google Business Profile** 
 is strongly preferred.
 



 The candidate should understand:
 


* Profile setup/optimisation
* Categories and business information
* Posts/updates
* Photos and content
* Genuine customer reviews
* Local\-search optimisation
* Search/Maps performance
* Local keyword research
* Connecting local visibility with lead generation



 The objective is to build
 **organic local visibility and generate enquiries** 
 , not merely maintain a profile. Google states that Business Profiles can appear in Search and Maps and provide performance information on searches, views and customer interactions.
 



**🧠 IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




**Experience in one or more of:** 



* Real\-estate digital marketing
* Organic lead generation
* Community marketing
* Reddit/Quora marketing
* SEO / Local SEO
* Google Business Profile
* Content marketing
* Digital market research
* Online customer acquisition
* Property lead generation
* Local business growth



**Real\-estate experience is strongly preferred** 
 , although an exceptional organic\-growth specialist with demonstrable results may also be considered.
 



**🏙️ KOLKATA MARKET KNOWLEDGE** 




**Kolkata\-based candidates preferred.** 




**Familiarity with markets such as:** 



* New Town / Rajarhat
* Salt Lake
* EM Bypass
* Joka
* Rajpur–Sonarpur
* Baruipur
* Garia
* Behala
* Thakurpukur
* Jadavpur
* VIP Road / Airport corridor
* South Kolkata
* Other emerging residential/investment corridors



 Actual focus areas will be determined by
 **real customer demand and available property inventory.** 




**👥 BUYER PERSONAS** 




**The candidate should understand different segments, including:** 



1. End\-users wanting to construct homes
2. Families looking for flats
3. First\-time buyers
4. Property investors
5. NRIs / people outside Kolkata
6. Affordable\-plot buyers
7. Higher\-budget buyers
8. Gated\-development buyers
9. Resale\-property buyers
10. Landowners/sellers seeking genuine buyers



 Each segment may require a different platform, message and conversion approach.
 



**✍️ CONTENT \& COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT** 




**The candidate should be able to create:** 



* Helpful Reddit responses
* Quora answers
* Medium articles
* Facebook Group posts/responses
* Local property content
* GBP updates
* Educational property content
* Location\-specific content
* Buyer guides
* Comparison content
* Property\-investment information



**Value first.** 




**We do NOT** 
 want:
 



 ❌ Spam
 



 ❌ Copy\-paste comments
 



 ❌ Mass unsolicited messages
 



 ❌ Fake accounts
 



 ❌ Artificial engagement
 



 ❌ Misleading claims
 



 ❌ Aggressive self\-promotion
 



 ❌ Violation of platform/community rules
 



 The approach should be:
 



**HELP → BUILD CREDIBILITY → CREATE INTEREST → GENERATE ENQUIRY** 




**📊 LEAD TRACKING \& ANALYTICS** 




**Maintain a systematic record of:** 



* Platform/community
* Post/question URL
* Customer requirement
* Location
* Budget
* Property type
* Date of engagement
* Response
* Lead status
* Contact obtained
* Follow\-up
* Qualified/unqualified
* Site visit/meeting
* Final outcome



 Continuously identify:
 



**Which platforms produce enquiries?** 




**Which topics attract buyers?** 




**Which locations generate demand?** 




**Which buyer segments respond?** 




**Which posts generate qualified leads?** 




**Which activities contribute to transactions?** 




**📈 PERFORMANCE IS NOT MEASURED BY POST COUNT** 




**We are not looking for someone who simply produces “50 posts per month.”** 




**The important funnel is:** 




**Relevant Conversations → Interested Prospects → Qualified Enquiries → Customer Requirements → Property Matching → Site Visits → Transactions → Revenue** 




**Quality of leads matters substantially more than content volume.** 




**💼 ENGAGEMENT MODEL** 




**We are open to:** 



* Performance\-based compensation
* Revenue\-sharing
* Profit\-sharing
* Fixed fee \+ performance incentive
* Low retainer \+ performance incentive
* Lead\-based compensation
* Hybrid arrangements



 The exact model will depend on experience, responsibilities and expected contribution.
 



**🚀 LONG\-TERM OPPORTUNITY** 




**This is intended to be more than a short\-term content assignment.** 




**A freelancer who consistently generates qualified property demand and measurable business opportunities** 
 can potentially become a long\-term
 **organic growth/customer acquisition partner** 
 for LandConnect \& PropNexa.
 



 We are looking for someone who thinks like:
 



**Researcher \+ Growth Marketer \+ Community Builder \+ Lead Generator \+ Real Estate Business Partner** 




**—not simply a Social Media Executive** 
 .
 



**📩 HOW TO APPLY** 




**Please provide:** 



1. Name
2. Current location
3. Relevant experience
4. Real\-estate experience, if any
5. Platforms worked with
6. Reddit / Quora / Medium experience
7. Google Business Profile / Local SEO experience
8. Free/low\-cost tools regularly used
9. Examples of organic leads generated
10. Portfolio / LinkedIn / work samples
11. Proposed working model
12. Expected fixed fee, if any
13. Preferred performance/revenue/profit\-sharing model



**⭐ PRACTICAL QUESTION** 




**“If you were given LandConnect \& PropNexa today and asked to generate 20 genuine Kolkata property\-buyer enquiries organically, without relying primarily on paid advertising, what would you do during your first 30 days?”** 




**Please provide:** 




**Platforms \+ Research Method \+ Tools \+ Content Approach \+ Engagement Strategy \+ Lead\-Generation Process \+ Measurement System** 




**Generic answers such as “I will do SEO, social media and content marketing”** 
 will not be sufficient.
 



 We are looking for a
 **practical operator who can actually find and generate property demand.** 




**Engagement:** 
 Freelance / Performance\-based / Potential Revenue or Profit\-sharing
 



**Primary Market:** 
 Kolkata
 



**Primary Objective:** 
 Generate genuine, qualified property leads through organic customer acquisition.
 



**🎯 STRATEGIC PRIORITY** 




**Initially, we would focus primarily on:** 




**1\. Existing Demand Discovery** 




**Reddit / Quora / Facebook Groups → Find people already asking for property.** 




**2\. Search Discovery** 




**Google Search \+ GBP → Capture people actively searching for property\-related services/information.** 




**3\. Authority Building** 




**Medium / Facebook / Instagram / YouTube → Build credibility and trust.** 




**The ultimate objective is to make the freelancer responsible for discovering and capturing organic property demand across the Kolkata digital ecosystem.**

title: Visual Storyteller
description:
Job Description – Visual Storyteller / Content Creator
 



**Company:** 
 NK Realtors
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing \& Communications
 



**Designation:** 
 Visual Storyteller / Content Creator
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹5–6 LPA
 



 About NK Realtors
 



 NK Realtors, established in 1987, is one of Eastern India’s leading real estate service providers, offering solutions across residential, commercial, land, investment advisory, project marketing and allied real estate services.
 



 As NK Realtors continues to strengthen its brand and digital presence, we are looking for a
 **Visual Storyteller who can turn ideas, people, projects and everyday moments into compelling content** 
 across digital platforms.
 



 The Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Creator, not someone who waits for a brief.** 




 Someone who lives and breathes
 **Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, photography, video and AI tools** 
 . Someone who sees a story and thinks,
 *“We should shoot this.”* 




 You could walk into the NK office and say:
 



**“Let's interview the CEO for 90 seconds.”** 




 Then you should be able to
 **conceptualise it, shoot it, edit it, caption it and publish it** 
 —and turn that one idea into multiple pieces of content.
 



 For example:
 



**1 idea → CEO Interview → LinkedIn Video → Instagram Reel → YouTube Short → Quote/Graphic → Story** 




 Key Responsibilities
 


* Conceptualise and create
 **short\-form video, reels, interviews, podcasts and social media content** 
 .
* Shoot and edit videos independently, including interviews, events, office culture, leadership content and project stories.
* Handle
 **photography and basic videography** 
 for NK Realtors.
* Repurpose one content idea into multiple platform\-specific formats.
* Create content for
 **Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other digital platforms** 
 .
* Develop short\-form interviews and leadership/personal\-brand content for senior management.
* Create basic
 **motion graphics, presentations, infographics and visual storytelling assets** 
 .
* Write basic captions, hooks and content copy suitable for different platforms.
* Use AI tools to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing and content creation.
* Identify trending formats, sounds, storytelling styles and platform opportunities.
* Experiment with new formats instead of simply following existing templates.
* Cover company events, employee stories, launches, campaigns and other brand moments.
* Maintain a consistent visual and content identity for NK Realtors.



 What We Are Looking For
 


* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in content creation, visual storytelling, digital media, advertising, social media or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience in
 **video creation, reels and photography** 
 .
* Comfortable being behind the camera as well as behind the editing screen.
* Ability to take an idea from
 **concept → shoot → edit → publish** 
 independently.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn content formats.
* Working knowledge of video editing and basic motion graphics tools.
* Comfortable using
 **AI\-powered creative and content tools** 
 .
* Good visual sense, storytelling ability and understanding of what makes content engaging.
* Strong communication skills and confidence in interacting with senior leaders, employees and external stakeholders.
* High ownership, curiosity and willingness to experiment.



 Preferred Background
 



 We would particularly welcome candidates from industries such as:
 



**FMCG \| Advertising \| Hospitality \| Premium Lifestyle \| Publishing \| Technology \| Media \| Digital Content** 




**Real estate experience is not mandatory.** 




 In fact, we would prefer someone who brings a
 **fresh content perspective from outside the real estate industry** 
 .
 



 The Right Mindset
 



 We are
 **not** 
 looking for someone whose digital content strategy is:
 



**Stock image \+ motivational quote \+ Canva template.** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Spots a story before being asked to create one.
* Is comfortable approaching people and asking questions.
* Is willing to experiment.
* Can turn everyday business moments into content.
* Understands that one idea can become five pieces of content.
* Can work independently without waiting for detailed briefs.
* Has the attitude to say
 **“Let's try it.”**



 Success in This Role
 



 The success of this role will be measured by the ability to consistently create
 **original, engaging and platform\-relevant content** 
 that strengthens NK Realtors' brand presence and visibility.
 



 Core Success Measure
 



**Don't wait for the brief. Find the story. Create it. Shoot it. Edit it. Multiply it. Publish it.**

title: Branch collection Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 IndoStar Capital Finance Limited (ICFL) is a professionally managed non\-banking financial company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India and co\-promoted by global investors Brookfield and Everstone. The company focuses on financial inclusion for retail customers in Tier 2 to Tier 4 markets by providing lending and credit solutions that support sustainable livelihoods. IndoStar offers a wide range of products, including finance for commercial vehicles, construction and farm equipment, cars and MUVs, small ticket business loans against property, and insurance. With assets under management of over ₹7,022 Crores, a network of more than 440 branches across India, and a customer base exceeding 100,000, IndoStar provides strong professional growth opportunities. The organization emphasizes competitive pricing, transparent terms, and long\-term value for customers and stakeholders.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Branch Collection Officer based in Kolkata and suburbans. The Branch Collection Officer will be responsible for managing collections from customers, ensuring timely repayments, and maintaining accurate records of payment status. The role includes visiting customers, discussing outstanding dues, negotiating repayment plans in line with company policies, and resolving queries or concerns related to loans. The Branch Collection Officer will coordinate with branch staff and the credit team to monitor portfolio performance, reduce delinquencies, and escalate issues when needed. The role also involves adherence to regulatory and company guidelines, maintaining professionalism in customer interactions, and supporting overall branch collection targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Debt Collection skills, including follow\-up, negotiation, and repayment monitoring.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess repayment behavior, identify risk patterns, and interpret collection reports.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills to manage customer relationships respectfully and handle complaints effectively.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills for in\-person discussions, phone calls, and documentation.
* Candidates should possess basic Finance knowledge related to loans, interest, EMI structures, and NBFC processes.
* Prior experience in collections, retail lending, or NBFC/banking operations is preferred.
* Minimum educational qualification: graduate degree in any discipline; additional certifications in finance or banking are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Prayagraj, travel locally as required, and meet branch collection targets.

title: Company Secretary
description: Experience: 1–2 Years Qualification: B.Com / CS Executive / CS Professional / Graduate in Commerce or related discipline Employment Type: Full\-time Reporting To: Senior Management / Finance Head 1\. Job Purpose The CS cum Accountant will provide day\-to\-day support in accounting, bookkeeping, company secretarial and statutory compliance activities of . This is a junior\-level role suitable for a candidate with 1–2 years of experience who has basic knowledge of accounting, Companies Act compliance, statutory filings and office documentation. The candidate will work closely with the senior management, accounts team, auditors, consultants and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of routine accounting and secretarial activities. 2\. Key Responsibilities A. Accounting \& Bookkeeping • Maintain day\-to\-day books of accounts and accounting records. • Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments and other financial transactions. • Assist in maintaining the General Ledger and supporting schedules. • Prepare and maintain invoices, vouchers and other accounting documents. • Assist with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable activities. • Perform basic bank and ledger reconciliations. • Maintain records of expenses and supporting documents. • Assist in month\-end and year\-end accounting activities. • Coordinate with auditors and external accountants for routine accounting requirements. B. Company Secretarial Activities • Assist in routine Company Secretarial and statutory compliance activities. • Maintain statutory registers, records and company documentation. • Assist in preparation of notices, agendas, minutes and resolutions for Board and general meetings. • Assist in preparation and filing of statutory forms and returns with the MCA/ROC. • Maintain records relating to directors, shareholders and shareholding. • Assist in maintaining minutes books and other secretarial records. • Track statutory compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of routine filings. • Assist the senior/consulting Company Secretary with ROC and other regulatory matters. • Support documentation related to appointment/resignation of directors, changes in company particulars and other corporate actions. C. Statutory \& Tax Compliance Support • Assist in maintaining documents and information required for statutory compliance. • Support the Accounts/Finance team in GST, TDS and other routine tax\-related activities. • Assist in preparing information and schedules required by auditors, tax consultants and statutory consultants. • Maintain proper records of statutory filings and challans. • Track compliance due dates and follow up with relevant stakeholders. D. Documentation \& Record Management • Maintain organized physical and digital records of accounting and secretarial documents. • Maintain statutory and corporate records in accordance with internal requirements. • Ensure proper filing of agreements, certificates, returns, challans, minutes and other documents. • Maintain confidentiality of company, financial and corporate information. E. Coordination \& General Support • Coordinate with external Company Secretary, Chartered Accountant, auditors and consultants. • Coordinate with banks, government departments and other external stakeholders as required. • Assist senior management with preparation of basic reports and information. • Follow up on pending documentation and compliance requirements. • Perform other accounting, secretarial and administrative duties assigned by management. 3\. Educational Qualification Preferred: • B.Com / B.Com (Hons.) or equivalent. • CS Executive / CS Professional candidates will be preferred. • Candidates pursuing Company Secretary qualification may also be considered. 4\. Experience • 1–2 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Company Secretarial or a similar role. • Experience in a CA/CS firm, corporate finance department or company secretarial function will be an advantage. • Candidates with internship/articleship exposure in accounting or secretarial work may also be considered. 5\. Technical Knowledge The candidate should have basic working knowledge of: • Bookkeeping and accounting principles. • Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable. • Bank reconciliation. • GST and TDS basics. • Companies Act and MCA/ROC compliance basics. • Preparation of minutes, resolutions and statutory documentation. • MS Excel and MS Office. • Accounting software such as Tally or similar ERP/accounting systems. • MCA portal and basic e\-filing processes. 6\. Key Skills \& Competencies • Good attention to detail. • Strong documentation and record\-keeping skills. • Basic understanding of accounting and corporate compliance. • Good numerical ability. • Good written and verbal communication. • Ability to follow up and work within statutory deadlines. • Good organizational and time\-management skills. • Willingness to learn. • Professional and disciplined approach. • Ability to maintain confidentiality. • Ability to work independently on routine assignments.

 IT Executive – Hardware, Networking \& IT Support
 



**Department:**

 Full\-Time

 **IT Executive**

 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of computers, networking infrastructure, internet connectivity, CCTV, biometric systems, printers, servers, and other IT\-enabled systems.

 1\. Hardware \& System Support
 


* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, projectors, and other IT equipment.

* Perform regular preventive maintenance of IT assets.
* Maintain proper records of IT equipment, repairs, replacements, and service history.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repair, replacement, warranty, and AMC\-related matters.

* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, access points, and other networking equipment.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, internet, and Wi\-Fi\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and networking vendors for service\-related problems.
* Configure and maintain routers, switches, and access points as required.
* Monitor network performance and identify recurring connectivity issues.
* Ensure proper network access and connectivity across classrooms, offices, laboratories, and other facilities.



 3\. IT Infrastructure \& Security
 


* Maintain IT infrastructure across different campuses and administrative offices.
* Ensure basic IT security practices, including password management, access control, antivirus, system updates, and backup procedures.
* Monitor and maintain CCTV, biometric attendance, access\-control systems, and other technology\-enabled security systems.
* Assist in identifying and resolving unauthorized device or network access issues.

* Install and configure operating systems, applications, drivers, and required software.
* Provide technical support to employees, faculty members, and administrative staff.
* Troubleshoot issues related to official email, online applications, cloud\-based platforms, and other institutional software.
* Assist users with basic IT\-related queries and provide timely resolution.

 **IT Asset Register** 
 covering computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, CCTV equipment, biometric devices, and other IT assets.
* Track asset allocation, movement, repair, replacement, and disposal.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets.
* Report damaged, missing, obsolete, or non\-functional equipment to the management.



 6\. Maintenance \& Vendor Coordination
 


* Coordinate with AMC/service providers for timely maintenance and repair of IT infrastructure.
* Maintain records of service calls, complaints, downtime, and resolution status.
* Follow up with vendors until issues are completely resolved.
* Verify service completion before closing maintenance requests.



 7\. Backup \& Data Management
 


* Assist in maintaining regular backups of important institutional data.
* Monitor backup status and report any failure or data\-access issue immediately.
* Follow organizational guidelines regarding data security and confidentiality.



 8\. MIS \& Reporting
 


* Prepare regular IT status reports for management.
* Maintain records of complaints, resolutions, downtime, maintenance, and pending issues.
* Provide daily/weekly reports as required by the reporting authority.
* Maintain proper documentation of all IT\-related activities.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Timely resolution of IT support tickets and technical complaints.
* Network and internet uptime.
* Timely preventive maintenance of IT infrastructure.
* Accuracy and regular updating of IT asset registers.
* Timely coordination and follow\-up with service providers.
* Reduction in recurring technical issues and downtime.
* Proper maintenance of IT documentation and reports.
* User satisfaction with IT support services.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's/Diploma degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, Electronics, or a related field** 
 .
* Relevant IT certifications will be an added advantage.



 Required Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, routers, and switches.
* Knowledge of Windows operating systems and common business applications.
* Basic understanding of IT security and data backup.
* Knowledge of CCTV and biometric systems will be an advantage.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple technical issues simultaneously.



 Preferred Experience
 


* **1–4 years of experience** 
 in IT support, hardware, networking, or infrastructure management.
* Experience in an
 **educational institution, corporate office, hospital, or multi\-location organization** 
 will be preferred.



 Working Requirements
 


* Willingness to travel between institutional campuses/offices whenever required.
* Ability to respond to urgent technical issues when required.
* Ability to work under deadlines and maintain proper documentation.
* Strong sense of responsibility, confidentiality, and service orientation.

title: Partner Guide
description:
About Walk Another Mile
 
 Walk Another Mile is a premium travel experiences and tour curation company dedicated to creating meaningful, immersive, and thoughtfully designed journeys for travellers.
 



 From curated cultural experiences and festival tours to heritage explorations and bespoke travel itineraries, we aim to connect guests with destinations through authentic storytelling, local insights, seamless coordination, and memorable experiences.
 



 As we expand our curated travel experiences in Kolkata and beyond, we are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and people\-oriented individuals to join our growing network of Partner Guides.
 


 Position Overview
 
 As a Partner Guide at Walk Another Mile, you will represent our brand on the ground and play a vital role in delivering exceptional experiences to our guests.
 



 You will be responsible for accompanying guests during assigned tours, guiding them through destinations and experiences, sharing interesting stories and cultural insights, managing on\-ground coordination, and ensuring that every guest feels welcomed, informed, and well cared for.
 



 This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy meeting new people, exploring destinations, sharing stories, and creating memorable travel experiences.
 



 This is an empanelment\-based, contractual engagement and not a permanent salaried employment position. Guides will be assigned tour opportunities based on guest requirements, availability, suitability, and performance.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Guest Experience \& Hospitality
 * Welcome guests warmly and professionally at designated meeting points.
* Maintain a friendly, approachable, and service\-oriented attitude throughout the tour.
* Understand guest expectations and provide attentive assistance.
* Ensure guests feel comfortable, safe, and well informed.
* Handle guest queries, requests, and reasonable concerns with patience and professionalism.
* Create a positive experience that reflects Walk Another Mile's standards.


 2\. Tour Guiding \& Storytelling
 * Lead guests through assigned tour routes, attractions, cultural sites, and experiences.
* Provide engaging explanations about local history, traditions, architecture, culture, and relevant points of interest.
* Share interesting anecdotes, lesser\-known facts, and contextual stories wherever appropriate.
* Make the experience interactive, engaging, and enjoyable.
* Adapt storytelling and communication to suit different guest profiles and interests.


 3\. Tour Coordination \& Route Management
 * Familiarise yourself with the assigned itinerary, route, meeting points, and inclusions before every assignment.
* Ensure smooth movement of guests between planned activities and destinations.
* Coordinate with drivers, vendors, coordinators, and other stakeholders when required.
* Manage time effectively and adhere to the planned itinerary.
* Remain flexible when minor adjustments are necessary due to crowds, weather, closures, or operational circumstances.


 4\. Crowd \& Situation Handling
 * Assist guests in navigating crowded areas, queues, public spaces, and busy tourist attractions.
* Remain calm and composed during unexpected situations.
* Escalate operational issues to the designated Walk Another Mile coordinator promptly.
* Assist in maintaining group cohesion and guest safety.
* Exercise sound judgment while handling on\-ground challenges.


 5\. Communication \& Reporting
 * Maintain clear and timely communication with the Walk Another Mile team.
* Provide updates regarding tour progress, guest requirements, and operational challenges.
* Report incidents, feedback, and relevant observations after assignments.
* Submit required post\-tour feedback or activity reports.
* Maintain professional communication before, during, and after every assignment.


 6\. Brand Representation
 * Represent Walk Another Mile with professionalism, integrity, and enthusiasm.
* Maintain appropriate grooming, attire, and personal conduct.
* Follow company guidelines regarding guest interaction, confidentiality, and service delivery.
* Uphold the reputation and values of Walk Another Mile during every guest interaction.


 Special Responsibilities During Kolkata Durga Puja Tours
 
 Selected Partner Guides may be assigned to our curated Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal Hopping Experiences.
 



 Responsibilities may include:
 


* Guiding guests through selected Durga Puja pandals and neighbourhoods.
* Sharing stories about Kolkata's Durga Puja traditions, history, artistry, and cultural significance.
* Assisting guests with navigating crowded streets and designated routes.
* Coordinating movement between pandals, meeting points, and vehicles.
* Helping guests understand local customs and festival etiquette.
* Managing time effectively during peak festival crowds.
* Supporting guests during street food walks and cultural experiences, where applicable.
* Ensuring the experience remains enjoyable, organised, and culturally respectful.



 Prior knowledge of Kolkata's Durga Puja culture and popular pandals will be an advantage.
 


 Candidate Profile
 
 We welcome applications from individuals who are passionate about travel, hospitality, culture, and guest experiences.
 


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Minimum educational qualification: 12th pass; graduates are preferred.
* Students pursuing college or university education are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates from Hospitality, Hotel Management, Tourism, Travel, History, Mass Communication, or related backgrounds are welcome.
* Prior experience in tour guiding, hospitality, customer service, event management, or guest relations is an advantage but not mandatory.


 Language Requirements
 
 Candidates should be comfortable communicating in:
 


* Bengali – Preferred
* English – Preferred
* Hindi – Preferred



 Proficiency in two or more of these languages will be an advantage, particularly for handling diverse groups of domestic and international travellers.
 


 Who Can Apply?
 
 This opportunity is suitable for:
 


* College and university students looking for flexible earning opportunities.
* Travel enthusiasts passionate about Kolkata's culture and heritage.
* Hospitality and Hotel Management students.
* Freelance tour guides and travel professionals.
* Hospitality professionals seeking additional assignment\-based opportunities.
* Individuals with strong communication and storytelling abilities.
* Durga Puja enthusiasts who possess excellent local knowledge.
* People who genuinely enjoy meeting and assisting travellers.
* Prior professional tour guiding experience is not compulsory. We value attitude, communication, reliability, local knowledge, and the willingness to learn.

title: Senior Analyst -I Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
 We are AML RightSource, the leading technology\-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
   

  

 Using a blend of highly trained anti\-financial crime professionals, cutting\-edge technology tools, and industry\-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
   

  

 We support clients in meeting day\-to\-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full\-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
   

  

**About The Position**
 A Senior Analyst I works with our clients (banks and non\-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing both quality control work related to the work of our Associate Analysts, and performing his/her own detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures. In short, you are on the front\-line of making decisions as to how to keep clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst I, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
   

  

 You may perform quality control activities, supervisory responsibility on occasion and be responsible for ad hoc communication with client. You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work, and you must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures, escalating where appropriate for second level review· Ability to perform quality control work as needed.
* Assist with advanced tasks including communication with clients, analyzing production data and creating client specific aids and training.
* Independently assist analyst with workflow items and administrative tasks as they arise.
* Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client\-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
* Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
* Work and contribute in a team\-oriented and collaborative environment.
* Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti\-Money, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree with 2\-3 year of relevant AML/BSA experience.
* Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint \& Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional Certification
* Strong knowledge of banking industry and related regulations and laws.
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities for improvement.


**Normal Working Hours and Conditions**
 Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position may require work to be performed outside of the core business hours based on Company operations across different time zones.
   

  

 AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e\-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job\-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





**HR Business Partner, Sales and Marketing** 




*Talent partner for the Sales and Marketing build\-out* 




**Position** 




 HR Business Partner (HRBP), Sales and Marketing.
 



**Function** 




 Human Resources, partnering the Sales and Marketing organization.
 



**Grade / Level** 




 Manager (not below)
 



**Reports to** 




 Talent Acquisition Leader, HR (solid line)
 



**Dotted line** 




 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer
 



**Covers** 




 The full S\&M structure: TMT regional sales, VAS, TOPTECH, Technical Services, Digital and CRM
 



**Location** 




 Head office with regional and field HR exposure
 



**Experience** 




 10 to 12 years in HR, from the building materials industry
 



  





**1\. Why this role exists** 




 SRMB is building a large Sales and Marketing organization fast: regional VPs and zonal heads for TMT, a VAS business with its own leadership, a penetration brand, national technical services, and digital and CRM engines. A structure this size, stood up at this pace, lives or dies on talent. The right people have to be found, hired and made productive quickly, and then kept. That is a full\-time job, and it needs a dedicated partner who knows the building materials talent market.
 



 The HRBP for Sales and Marketing is that partner. This role owns talent acquisition and ramp\-up for the S\&M organization, partners the leadership on manpower planning, onboarding, performance and retention, and turns the org charts into filled, performing teams. It reports on a solid line to the Talent Acquisition Leader in HR and on a dotted line to the President and CSMO, so it serves the business closely while staying anchored in the HR function.
 



  





**2\. What this role owns** 



* **Talent acquisition and ramp\-up.** 
 Hire across the S\&M structure and, above all, ramp new talent to productivity fast, from leadership roles to the field.
* **Manpower planning.** 
 Partner S\&M leaders on the manpower plan, role design and prioritization, so hiring tracks the growth plan.
* **Onboarding and time to productivity.** 
 Own structured onboarding and the 30\-60\-90 day journey so new hires deliver sooner.
* **Performance and capability.** 
 Support KRA setting, reviews and capability building across the S\&M teams.
* **Engagement and retention.** 
 Track engagement, manage early attrition, and keep the talent the business has invested in.



  





**3\. Key responsibilities** 



* **Turn the org charts into teams.** 
 Drive hiring against the S\&M manpower plan, close roles to time and quality, and keep the pipeline warm.
* **Ramp talent fast.** 
 Run onboarding, buddy and early\-support programmes that cut time to productivity, and track it as a number.
* **Partner the S\&M leaders.** 
 Work with the VPs and heads on structure, role clarity, KRAs and people decisions, as a trusted business partner.
* **Own the HR cycle for S\&M.** 
 Run performance, confirmation, engagement and retention actions across the S\&M organization.
* **Manage early attrition.** 
 Spot flight risk and early exits, find the causes, and fix them before they cost the business.
* **Bridge business and HR.** 
 Represent S\&M needs to the HR function and HR standards to the business, cleanly, on both reporting lines.



  





**4\. Measurable indices** 




  





**What it measures** 




  





  





**Fill rate** 




**What it measures** 
 Positions filled against the S\&M manpower plan
 



**Target 90%\+ on plan** 




  





**Time to fill** 




**What it measures** 
 Days to close a role
 



**Target Within agreed benchmark** 




  





**Ramp\-up speed** 




**What it measures** 
 Time from joining to productivity
 



**Target Compressing quarter on quarter** 




  





**Offer to join** 




**What it measures** 
 Offers accepted and actually joined
 



**Target 90%\+ join ratio** 




  





**Early attrition** 




**What it measures** 
 Exits within the first 6 to 12 months
 



**Target Below the agreed threshold** 




  





**Quality of hire** 




**What it measures** 
 New\-hire confirmation and performance
 



**Target High and rising** 




  





**Onboarding** 




**What it measures** 
 30\-60\-90 day onboarding completion
 



**Target 100%** 




  





**Engagement and retention** 




**What it measures** 
 S\&M engagement score and regretted attrition
 



**Target Improving year on year** 




  





**5\. Who we are looking for** 



* 10 to 12 years in HR, as an HRBP or in talent acquisition, from the building materials industry: steel, cement, paints, tiles, pipes or construction chemicals.
* At Manager level and not below, with the maturity to partner senior S\&M leaders as an equal.
* A proven record of ramping up talent, having built or scaled teams at pace in a prior role.
* Real knowledge of the building materials sales and marketing talent market, and where the right people sit.
* Strong on hiring, onboarding, performance partnering and retention, and comfortable working two reporting lines.
* MBA in HR preferred, with data fluency and a field\-ready, hands\-on style.



  





**6\. What good looks like in year one** 




 The S\&M org charts are becoming filled, performing teams. Roles are closing to time and quality, new hires are productive faster because onboarding and early support actually work, and early attrition is under control. The S\&M leaders treat the HRBP as a genuine partner, HR standards hold on both reporting lines, and talent has stopped being the thing that slows the growth plan down.
 



  





 Salary \- Up to 10 LPA CTC.

title: Mechanical Inspector
description:
A Mechanical Inspector is a professional who ensures that mechanical systems, equipment, and components meet established safety, quality, and performance standards. They are responsible for inspecting and testing mechanical systems and equipment to ensure they are in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, as well as industry standards. This includes inspecting and testing HVAC systems, plumbing systems, elevators, and other mechanical equipment. The role of a Mechanical Inspector is critical in ensuring the safety and functionality of mechanical systems in buildings, homes, and other structures. They may work in a variety of settings, including construction sites, manufacturing facilities, and in government or private inspection firms. They also work closely with other professionals, including engineers, contractors, and architects, to ensure that mechanical systems are designed and installed correctly and meet all relevant regulations. In addition to inspecting and testing mechanical systems, Mechanical Inspectors may also be responsible for preparing reports, documenting findings, and providing recommendations for repairs or improvements. They may also be called upon to provide expert testimony in legal proceedings related to mechanical systems and equipment.

title: Associate Analyst- II Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**
 An Associate Analyst II works with our clients (banks and non\-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures In short, you are on the front\-line of making decisions as to how to keep our clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.
   

  

 As an Associate Analyst II, you research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
   

  

 You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work and must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Evaluate and monitor transactional activity to assess potential suspicious activity.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
* Interpret and implement client\-operating policies regarding financial data.
* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client\-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
* Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
* Complete advanced tasks, such as providing peer support and training.
* Conduct quality reviews, as needed.
* Meet production and quality standards for completing assignments.
* Work and contribute in a team\-oriented and collaborative environment.
* Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti\-Money Laundering, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree with 1 year of relevant AML/BSA, Fraud, or Compliance experience.
* Strong oral communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel \& Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities for improvement.


 Normal Working Hours and Conditions
   

  

 Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position may require work to be performed outside of the core business hours based on Company operations across different time zones.
   

  

**Physical Requirements**
 Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in office setting; to stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; to work at a computer for a minimum of eight hours; to occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; to lift, carry, push, and/or pull light to moderate amounts of weight.; to operate office equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard and mouse; to travel to other office locations and to communicate with others.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Customer Centricity
   

  

* Put the customer’s voice at the center of all decision\-making.
* Ask ourselves “will this benefit the customer?” before making any decisions.
* Use our expertise to guide and support our customer to achieve their goals.
* Work with other functions and teams to drive business performance with our customers.


 ACT Feedback Model
   

  

* Before giving feedback, be clear on how a specific behavior change will help the individual or the company. Giving feedback to get frustration off your chest or intentionally hurt the other person is not tolerated.
* Be precise in giving or receiving feedback so that specific inputs can lead to better outcomes.
* Listen to and consider all feedback provided. Work with your manager to determine whether to take this feedback forward or disregard it.


 AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e\-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job\-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

 About STEM Learning
 
 STEM Learning Pvt. Ltd. is a CSR\-funded social enterprise working in STEM education across India. The organisation works with corporates, government bodies and schools to implement large\-scale education and social\-impact programs.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and execution\-focused
 **Executive Assistant to the CEO – Operations** 
 who will work closely with the CEO to
 **track, coordinate and monitor key operational priorities across the organisation** 
 .
 



 This is not limited to traditional executive assistance. The role will act as an important
 **coordination and monitoring layer between the CEO and various functional/operations teams** 
 , ensuring that key priorities, commitments, action items and deadlines are tracked and followed through.
 



 The person will be expected to understand ongoing operational matters, seek regular updates from respective teams, identify delays or gaps, escalate critical issues and provide the CEO with clear and timely updates.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across multiple functions, following up with senior stakeholders, handling confidential information and working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Operations Tracking \& Monitoring
 * Work closely with the CEO to track important operational priorities across the organisation.
* Maintain visibility on key initiatives, projects, deadlines and commitments assigned to different teams.
* Regularly collect and consolidate updates from functional and operational teams.
* Track progress against agreed timelines and highlight delays, dependencies and bottlenecks.
* Follow up with respective stakeholders to ensure timely closure of pending action items.
* Maintain an updated tracker of key operational priorities and action points.
* Identify areas requiring the CEO's attention and escalate them appropriately.
* Ensure that important operational updates do not remain pending or uncommunicated.


 2\. CEO Updates \& Reporting
 * Prepare regular and concise updates for the CEO on the status of key operational activities.
* Consolidate information received from different departments into clear management\-level updates.
* Highlight completed activities, pending items, delays, critical issues and required interventions.
* Ensure the CEO has timely visibility of operational developments.
* Prepare daily/weekly trackers, MIS and status reports as required.
* Support the CEO in reviewing organisational priorities and follow\-up actions.


 3\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 * Coordinate closely with Operations, Programs, HR, Finance, CSR Partnerships, Sales and other functional teams.
* Act as a coordination point between the CEO's office and department heads/team leaders.
* Follow up on tasks and commitments arising from meetings or discussions with the CEO.
* Ensure action items have clear ownership and timelines.
* Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to obtain information, updates and required documents.
* Maintain professional and timely communication with internal stakeholders.


 4\. Action Item \& Follow\-Up Management
 * Record and track action items arising from CEO meetings and discussions.
* Maintain a central action tracker with responsibility, timelines and status.
* Follow up proactively with stakeholders before deadlines.
* Flag overdue or delayed action items to the CEO.
* Ensure closure updates are documented and communicated.
* Follow through on critical matters until completion rather than limiting the role to coordination.


 5\. Meeting \& Review Coordination
 * Coordinate meetings involving the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.
* Prepare agendas, background information and relevant updates before meetings.
* Ensure the required data and information is available before review meetings.
* Document key discussions, decisions and action points.
* Track post\-meeting actions and follow up with respective owners.
* Support periodic operational reviews and management meetings.


 6\. Operational Problem Tracking
 * Develop an understanding of ongoing operational challenges across functions.
* Identify recurring delays, gaps or dependencies through regular follow\-ups.
* Bring critical operational concerns to the CEO's attention with relevant facts and status.
* Coordinate with concerned teams to understand the issue and current action plan.
* Maintain visibility on resolution timelines and follow up until closure.


 7\. Calendar \& Priority Management
 * Manage and coordinate the CEO's calendar based on organisational priorities.
* Schedule internal and external meetings and ensure appropriate prioritisation.
* Avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure adequate preparation time for important meetings.
* Prepare the CEO with relevant briefs, documents, presentations and updates before key meetings.
* Track follow\-up requirements arising from meetings.


 8\. Communication \& Documentation
 * Draft and coordinate professional internal and external communications on behalf of the CEO where required.
* Prepare notes, summaries, presentations, trackers and reports.
* Maintain organised records of important operational and management documents.
* Ensure sensitive and confidential information is handled with appropriate discretion.
* Maintain proper documentation of key decisions, commitments and action items.


 9\. Travel \& Logistics
 * Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for the CEO where required.
* Manage itineraries, accommodation, meeting schedules and related logistics.
* Coordinate travel\-related documentation and expense reporting.
* Ensure travel plans are aligned with the CEO's meeting and operational schedule.


 10\. Special Projects \& Strategic Initiatives
 * Support the CEO on special projects and organisation\-wide initiatives.
* Assist in research, data gathering, presentations and management reports.
* Support the CEO in tracking strategic initiatives and their execution.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely progress on special assignments.
* Take ownership of ad\-hoc assignments and ensure timely completion.


 Key Deliverables
 
 The person in this role will be expected to ensure:
 


* Clear visibility of important operational priorities for the CEO.
* Timely collection and consolidation of operational updates.
* Regular follow\-up on pending actions and commitments.
* Early identification and escalation of delays and critical issues.
* Accurate and timely MIS/trackers for management review.
* Effective coordination between the CEO's office and functional teams.
* Closure of action items within agreed timelines.
* Better visibility and accountability on organisation\-wide operational priorities.


 Required Qualifications \& Experience
 * Bachelor's degree is required.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* **3–6 years of relevant experience** 
 in Executive Assistance, Operations Coordination, Project Coordination, Management Office, CEO Office or a similar role.
* Experience working directly with senior management/CXO\-level leadership will be preferred.
* Candidates with exposure to operations, project tracking or cross\-functional coordination will be preferred.


 Required Skills \& CompetenciesCommunication
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with senior stakeholders.
* Strong ability to prepare concise management\-level updates.


 Organisation \& Follow\-Up
 * Strong organisational and time\-management skills.

 Analytical \& Reporting Skills

 Execution Orientation

 You will progressively take over the functions the Founding Partner handles personally and own them end\-to\-end – across finance, operations, supply chain, sales and administration. * Schedule and run review meetings as required, and hold teams accountable to outcomes.

 In short, anything and everything an entrepreneur would do to keep the business running and moving forward.
 



**What You Will Gain**

title: Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $1,600,000/year USD
description:
Most finance executives inherit a system. You will redesign one, then decide where the capital goes.
   

  

 Trilogy is looking for the executive who can turn a portfolio of businesses into a capital allocation system: continuously ranking where the next dollar should go, backing those decisions with rigorous models, and moving capital toward its highest\-return uses. You will own the calls that matter: fund or kill a business line; invest or hold; acquire or walk away; refinance or pay down debt. Every recommendation must connect strategy to cash, liquidity, covenants, risk, and enterprise value.
   

  

 Just as important, you will architect an AI\-native finance function built to scale without decision bottlenecks. This does not mean sprinkling AI tools onto a traditional finance organization. You will redesign reporting, planning, controls, portfolio monitoring, and decision support around what AI and automation can now do. You won't need to personally build every workflow, but you must use AI deeply enough to know its edges: where it accelerates analysis, where it fails, and where expert judgment must take over. The result should be a smaller, more senior, higher\-leverage finance organization rather than a growing pyramid of people and processes.
   

  

 You will operate directly with Trilogy's CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners, with personal accountability for the financial truth behind major decisions. As Deputy CFO, this is a $1\.6M/year W\-2 salaried role for someone who has already earned credibility at serious financial scale and now wants the mandate to compound enterprise value across an entire portfolio. If you want your impact measured by the quality of your capital decisions and the financial system you leave behind, apply.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Allocating capital across the portfolio: Run capital and portfolio reviews, rank competing uses of capital on risk\-adjusted return, and make clear fund, hold, restructure, exit, debt\-paydown, or acquisition recommendations.
* Architecting an AI\-native finance system: Redesign planning, reporting, consolidation, controls, portfolio monitoring, and financial workflows around AI, automation, and scalable systems rather than additional headcount.
* Driving investments and transactions: Build and defend the financial case for strategic investments, M\&A, financing, and refinancing, including integrated models, downside scenarios, capital structure, covenant implications, and execution plans.
* Owning board and capital\-partner communication: Give the CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners fast, quantified, defensible truth, with recommendations that make the decision and trade\-offs explicit.
* Building a high\-leverage finance leadership team: Set the bar for a small group of exceptional finance leaders while creating systems that allow new ventures and greater complexity to be absorbed without linear organizational growth.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Running finance as a reporting factory. Closing the books and producing audit workpapers are the Controller's responsibilities. Your job is to turn financial information into better capital decisions.
* Building a large finance organization to handle complexity. Scale should come from better systems, AI leverage, automation, and exceptional people, not layers of management.
* Adding AI as a superficial productivity tool. You will architect workflows around its real capabilities and limitations, which requires substantial firsthand use.
* Producing strategy decks without financial consequences. Major recommendations must carry the integrated model, downside case, capital implications, and execution guardrails behind them.
* Managing the board through narrative. The numbers, assumptions, risks, and recommended action should be clear enough to withstand scrutiny.


**Deputy Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities**
 Build a durable, AI\-native finance function that compounds enterprise value across Trilogy's portfolio by allocating capital to its highest\-return uses and creating financial systems and controls that scale without decision bottlenecks.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Experience as the most senior finance decision\-maker, or their direct deputy, for a business or portfolio with $100M\+ in annual revenue across multiple legal entities.
* Personal ownership of major capital\-allocation decisions, including the ability to explain what was funded, reduced, or rejected; the dollars involved; the trade\-offs; and your recommendation.
* Decision ownership on at least one $25M\+ closed M\&A, financing, or refinancing transaction, with direct responsibility for negotiation, financing selection, board recommendation, or post\-close integration.
* Direct experience presenting to and taking live questions from a board of directors.
* Ownership of an external audit relationship under US GAAP or IFRS, directly or through a Controller reporting to you.
* Hands\-on experience with a true enterprise ERP such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent.
* Recent experience re\-architecting a finance workflow around AI, with enough regular personal AI use to understand where the technology is reliable, where it is not, and how those boundaries should shape finance\-system design.
* Ability to operate integrated 3\-statement models and defend assumptions, downside scenarios, covenant math, capital structure, and recommendations under live questioning.
* Strong written and verbal English, with experience communicating directly with CEOs, boards, lenders, or capital partners.
* Located within the UTC−8 to UTC\+3 time\-zone range.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, MBA, or comparable finance credential.
* Earlier career experience in private equity, investment banking, M\&A, corporate finance, or another environment requiring rigorous modeling and high\-stakes capital decisions.
* Experience rebuilding a finance function rather than simply inheriting and operating one.
* Experience across a portfolio, multi\-entity, or PE\-backed operating environment.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $800 USD/hour, which equates to $1,600,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- PAM Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage and contribute to the Identity \& Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 3\-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages\- Python, JSON, Ruby, C\#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud\-native/cloud\-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 3\-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification


**Certifications:**
* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur


**What We Look For**
* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands\-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
