title: TC - CS - CTM - AppSec - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**CTM Senior Manager – Application Security**
**Overview**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you will help secure applications and platforms while ensuring seamless development, build, and deployment capabilities. You will be responsible for designing secure software by identifying security use cases during the design and development stages, including emerging risks from AI/ML\-enabled applications. You will work closely with DevOps, architects, developers, and QA teams to build highly reliable and secure products. You will also coach development teams on building a strong security culture and provide recommendations on vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and the responsible adoption of AI\-driven technologies.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Application Security \& DevSecOps to lead high\-impact application security engagements for enterprise clients. You will drive delivery, mentor teams, expand client relationships, and shape practice offerings across Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Modeling, and AI/ML security.
   

  

 This role involves enabling organizations to securely adopt GenAI and AI\-driven solutions, ensuring risks are effectively managed while supporting innovation. This is a client\-facing leadership role requiring both strong technical depth and executive\-level communication.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery \& Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end application security assessments (SAST/DAST/SCA, penetration testing, secure code review, threat modeling).
* Design and implement Secure SDLC frameworks for Agile/DevOps environments.
* Advise CISOs and CTOs on application security strategy, roadmaps, and ROI.
* Manage large multi\-workstream engagements.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including risk assessments, governance, and secure enterprise integration.
* Lead client\-facing engagements to assess and secure AI/ML applications, providing strategic direction on risk management, governance, and mitigation of vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and data exposure.


**Practice Development**
* Develop proprietary methodologies, accelerators, and IP in AppSec (e.g., AI\-driven secure coding, intelligent vulnerability prioritization, zero\-trust application architecture).
* Contribute to thought leadership — whitepapers, webinars, conference talks (Black Hat, RSA, OWASP).
* Support proposal development and deal closure for strategic pursuits.
* Build and enhance AI security offerings, including GenAI security frameworks and AI risk governance models.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor and performance\-manage a team of 20–25 consultants (Managers, Seniors, Analysts).
* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience building enterprise\-scale AppSec and DevSecOps programs from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, research, or open\-source initiatives in application security.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST SSDF).
* Executive presence — ability to influence CxOs and translate complex technical risks into business outcomes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE / B.Tech / MCA.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of experience in application security, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or security architecture.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

 , while reducing complexity and accelerating delivery.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The
 **AVP, Senior Product Engineer** 
 is responsible for administering, supporting, troubleshooting, and optimizing SAS Viya environments deployed on AWS and Kubernetes (Amazon EKS). This role requires strong expertise in SAS Viya platform administration, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, Terraform\-based infrastructure as code, security, authentication, and enterprise system integrations.
   

  

 The position plays a critical role in ensuring platform stability, performance, scalability, and security while supporting modernization and migration initiatives from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.0\. The administrator will collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, IAM, network, database, and application teams to deliver reliable enterprise analytics platform services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The role involves end\-to\-end operational ownership of SAS Viya 4 environments and associated AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure components.
   

  

* Administer and support SAS Viya 4 environments in enterprise production settings.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patching, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage SAS Viya services, compute environments, CAS, SAS Studio, users, groups, roles, and authorization controls.
* Troubleshoot application, compute, storage, and performance issues within SAS Viya.
* Support and manage SAS Viya deployments on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to pods, deployments, services, persistent volumes, storage, nodes, resource limits, and application logs.
* Configure and troubleshoot integrations between SAS Viya and AWS services including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, and VPC components.
* Manage IAM roles, policies, service accounts, permissions, and cross\-account accessrequirements.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Terraform\-based infrastructure as code for cloud resources and platform deployments.
* Create and manage Terraform modules, variables, plans, state files, and deployment workflows.
* Configure and support enterprise authentication and SSO integrations using Okta, SAML, LDAP/Active Directory, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies.
* Troubleshoot authentication, MFA, authorization, SSO, and role\-mapping issues.
* Support platform security requirements including certificates, TLS/SSL, networking, and connectivity.
* Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, and optimization across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Terraform, Python, Shell, and SAS scripting.
* Support migration activities from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.
* Collaborate with AWS, Security, IAM, Network, Database, and Application teams to ensure seamless platform operations.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
 Candidates must demonstrate strong technical depth across SAS Viya administration, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in SAS Administration.
* Hands\-on experience administering SAS Viya 4 environments.
* Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, S3, Lambda and VPC.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVC/PV, Storage Classes, and resource management.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Experience with enterprise authentication technologies such as Okta, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of LDAP/Active Directory and role\-based access control.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience with SAS Viya monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Python and Shell scripting for automation.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
 The ideal candidate will bring a combination of strong technical capability, operational discipline, and collaboration skills to support a modern enterprise analytics platform.
   

  

* Experience with SAS 9\.4 Grid/SAS Viya 4 administration.
* SAS Viya or AWS certification.
* Exposure to Helm, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, or CI/CD tools and practices.
* Experience with AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, or other cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments and cloud migration projects.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams in infrastructure, security, and application domains.
* Proactive approach to automation, optimization, and operational improvement.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 6\-10 Years of Total experience, 3\-4 years of SAS Viya Administration, and 2\-3 years of AWS experience, having hood hands\-on and knowledge in Terraform/DevOps/Jenkins.

title: Piping Engineer / Senior Piping Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Piping Engineer with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Piping Design \& Layout Engineering:
+ Develop piping layouts for mining, mineral processing, and metal extraction facilities based on P\&IDs, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and client specifications.
+ Ensure the layout design optimizes space, operational efficiency, and ease of installation while meeting industry safety and environmental standards.
+ Prepare detailed piping design drawings, including routing, support placement, and equipment integration.
+ Coordinate the layout of piping systems with other engineering disciplines such as civil, mechanical, and electrical to ensure seamless integration.
+ Select appropriate materials for piping systems based on factors such as fluid type, temperature, pressure, and environmental conditions.

* FEED (Front\-End Engineering Design):
+ Participate in the FEED phase of projects, assisting in the development of piping layouts and preliminary designs.
+ Work with multidisciplinary teams to define project scope, estimate costs, and identify potential design challenges.
+ Review client specifications and ensure the design aligns with technical, budgetary, and scheduling requirements.
+ Contribute to the development of initial piping design concepts, material take\-offs, and cost estimates.

* Detailed Engineering Design:
+ Prepare detailed engineering designs for the full scope of piping systems, including pipe sizes, materials, valves, and fittings, as well as system integration.
+ Use S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar CAD software to develop accurate piping design drawings and layouts.
+ Coordinate with the stress analysis team to address any piping support and stress\-related issues.
+ Ensure that all piping designs comply with applicable industry standards and codes (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, etc.).

* Layout Optimization:
+ Optimize piping layout designs for both new projects and modifications to existing plants by minimizing material usage, reducing installation time, and enhancing operational efficiency.
+ Review existing designs to identify potential areas for improvement and ensure that the piping layout adheres to best practices and operational needs.

* Coordination \& Communication:
+ Work closely with internal teams, clients, contractors, and vendors to ensure the timely and successful completion of projects.
+ Participate in 3D design reviews, safety meetings, and project coordination meetings to track progress and mitigate risks.
+ Maintain clear and consistent communication regarding project milestones, design changes, and any potential challenges.

* Quality Control \& Compliance:
+ Ensure the piping design meets quality standards and safety regulations in accordance with project requirements, local regulations, and industry codes.
+ Perform thorough checks to confirm design accuracy, material selection, and compliance with specifications.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in piping design, layout engineering, and detailed engineering in the mining, mineral, and metal industries or related heavy industries.
* Proficient in S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar 3D CAD software used for piping design.
* In\-depth knowledge of piping codes and standards (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, ISO) and the ability to apply them effectively in design.
* Experience in FEED and detailed design phases of projects, from initial concept to final design.
* Familiarity with stress analysis and material selection for various operating conditions (pressure, temperature, and corrosion resistance).
* Strong understanding of piping layout principles, including routing, spacing, support design, and integration with equipment and structures.
* Experience working on large\-scale mining or metallurgical plant projects.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
Position Purpose
 
 The Operations \& Strategy Lead acts as the chief liaison and operational bridge between the Promoter/Managing Director and the factory floor. Stationed permanently at the plant, this person ensures strict execution of management directives, monitors operational and financial KPIs across production and utilities, tracks customer dispatches and receivables, and coordinates business development initiatives.
 



 This is a high\-ownership operational role for a commercially sharp operator who wants to learn how to run a mid\-market industrial manufacturing enterprise.
 



  





**Location:** 
 On\-site daily at Manufacturing Facility, Hooghly, West Bengal
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Managing Director / Promoter
 



**Working Relationship:** 
 Works alongside the Plant Head, QA/QC Lead, and Commercial Accounts Team
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3–6 years post\-MBA (or equivalent operational experience)
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Promoter Cockpit \& Daily Plant Governance
 * Review and validate the Daily Production Report (DPR) generated by the plant team
* Independently flag operational anomalies, line stoppages, unapproved material consumption, or safety/maintenance lapses directly to the Managing Director.
* Track the daily utility consumption and performance metrics of the HVAC systems, chillers, and newly commissioned heat pump systems against baseline power targets.
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and management directives are rigorously implemented across the shop\-floor staff.
* Prepare monthly executive MIS presentations detailing gross margins, direct cost breakdowns, debtor aging, and capacity utilisation trends for promoter review.



  




 2\. Commercial Coordination, Dispatches \& Working Capital
 * Act as the daily bridge between customer orders and plant production schedules, ensuring priority batches for key institutional accounts are produced and packaged on schedule.
* Track raw material inventory levels and reconcile daily consumption against purchasing ledgers to prevent stockouts or over\-procurement.
* Coordinate daily logistics, freight haulers, and e\-way billing for on\-time dispatches to formulation hubs in North, West, and East India.
* Assist the Managing Director in monitoring customer ledger aging, coordinating with client procurement desks to resolve dispatch disputes, and ensuring customer collection cycles remain strictly within the targeted 60–90 day window.



  




 3\. Business Development \& Sales Enablement

**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:** 
**2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

* And the ability to work with distributed teams and support global users

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.

description:

**AIA – Mainframe Modernization Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist** 
 to join our
 **AI\-Driven Modernization** 
 practice, focused on transforming
 **legacy mainframe systems** 
 into agile, efficient, and cloud\-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of
 **mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies** 
 along with
 **hands\-on collaboration** 
 with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud\-native platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding


* 
+ Assess and analyse existing mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS) to identify modernization opportunities and dependencies.
+ Document current\-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.

+ AI\-Driven Mainframe Modernization


* 
+ Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
+ Develop and fine\-tune AI\-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
+ Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM\-driven modernization workflows.
+ Modernization Execution


* 
+ Execute modernization tasks including rehosting, refactoring, or rebuilding mainframe workloads based on defined strategies.
+ Participate in the design and implementation of target\-state architectures aligned with cloud\-native and microservices patterns.
+ Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.
+ API and Microservices Development


* 
+ Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
+ Implement RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target\-state solution.
+ Cloud and Platform Integration


* 
+ Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven solutions.
+ Integrate modernized components with cloud\-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
+ Documentation and Reporting


* 
+ Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
+ Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 9 years of hands\-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
* Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
* Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML certifications, or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global teams to drive real business impact through digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and technology leaders in a highly innovative environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.

* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

* Schedule aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds, HR interviews, and other recruitment activities.

* Coordinate student participation in off\-campus and on\-campus recruitment activities.

* Visit corporate offices, companies, training organizations, and industry partners as required.

* Willingness to travel within and outside Kolkata/West Bengal for placement and corporate relations activities, as required.

* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management from time to time in connection with Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations, Student Development, or Institutional Activities.



**Eligibility \& Qualification** 




**Essential Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institution.
* Minimum
 **6\-7 years of relevant experience** 
 in Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations,



**Preferred Qualification** 



* Master's Degree in Management, HR, Business Administration, Education, or a relevant discipline.
* Prior experience in an educational institution, university, college, training organization will be preferred.



**Essential Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Good presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly
 **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Ability to maintain MIS, databases, reports, and official documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with students, faculty members, management, and corporate representatives.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for corporate meetings, recruitment drives, industry visits, and institutional activities.



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The ideal candidate should be:
 


* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Confident and professional in communication.
* Well\-organized and disciplined.
* Comfortable interacting with students, faculty, management, and corporate professionals.
* Capable of working independently as well as part of a team.
* Flexible to handle multiple responsibilities and institutional requirements.

**Why Join KEI?**

* Opportunity to contribute directly to student career development and institutional placement initiatives.

title: Senior Dealer
description:
**Company Description** 
 SMIFS Limited is a leading wealth management and financial services company with over three decades of experience supporting investors, high\-net\-worth individuals, corporates, and institutions across India. Founded in 1991, the firm is driven by a client\-first philosophy, research\-backed decisions, and disciplined risk management. SMIFS offers comprehensive solutions across wealth management, equities and market access, insurance, institutional services, and structured and legacy planning. The company focuses on tailored financial strategies that align with client goals, risk profiles, and life stages, helping them navigate market cycles and build long\-term wealth. SMIFS operates under multiple SEBI, AMFI, IRDAI, and other regulatory registrations, reinforcing its commitment to compliance and trust.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Dealer role is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Kolkata, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Senior Dealer will execute and manage equity, derivatives, and other market orders on behalf of clients, ensuring timely and accurate trade execution in line with regulatory norms and internal risk guidelines. Responsibilities include monitoring markets in real time, analyzing trading opportunities, managing client positions, and coordinating with the research and advisory teams to implement recommended strategies. The role involves regular interaction with clients and relationship managers to understand investment objectives, provide execution\-related insights, and maintain a high standard of service. The Senior Dealer will also contribute to compliance reporting, trade reconciliations, and continuous improvement of dealing desk processes and systems.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of capital markets, including equities, derivatives, and other traded instruments, along with practical experience on major exchanges and trading platforms.
* Proficiency in trade execution, order management, position monitoring, and risk management within a regulated dealing environment.
* Ability to interpret market research, technical and fundamental analysis, and apply them to day\-to\-day trading and client strategies.
* Excellent numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort working with trading software, OMS/RMS systems, and Excel\-based tools.
* Clear, professional communication skills to interact with clients, relationship managers, and internal teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements related to brokerage, trading, and client order handling.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, commerce, economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM, NCFM) are preferred.
* Prior experience in a dealing desk role with a brokerage, wealth management, or financial services firm is highly beneficial.

title: Executive Assistant to the President
description:
**SRMB STEEL** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Executive Assistant to the President \& CSMO** 




**Position Title** 




 Executive Assistant (EA) to the President \& Chief Sales and Marketing Officer
 



**Reports To** 




 President \& CSMO (single reporting line)
 



**Base Location** 




 Kolkata, Corporate Head Office (anchors HQ operations during principal's field travel)
 



**Function / Band** 




 Executive Office / Business Support (Senior Manager equivalent)
 



**Experience Required** 




 12\+ years as EA to a Director / CXO in a large manufacturing organization (non\-negotiable)
 



**Span of Coordination** 




 Interfaces with 10 direct reports of the CSMO, HODs, plant \& regional sales leadership, and the MD's office
 



  





**1\. Purpose of the Role** 




 SRMB Steel is scaling toward a ₹5,000 Cr turnover ambition, and the Office of the President \& CSMO sits at the centre of that push. This office consolidates every sales, marketing, MIS and analytics stream while the CSMO spends much of the next twelve months in the field, driving the retail run across a digital\-rich, multi\-brand product architecture (core TMT, binding range, structural\-retail brands and the project/institutional business).
 



 The Executive Assistant is the operating spine of this office. Not a diary\-keeper, but a trusted second brain: someone who runs the HQ cockpit when the principal is travelling, keeps information flowing without friction, turns raw data into decision\-ready briefs, and protects the CSMO's time and focus with judgement and discretion. This is a career EA role for a seasoned professional who takes quiet pride in flawless execution.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Executive Office \& Time Management** 



* **Calendar command:** 
 Own the CSMO's calendar end\-to\-end: prioritising, sequencing and defending time against competing demands from HODs, the MD's office, dealers, and external partners.
* **Operating rhythm:** 
 Run the daily and weekly operating rhythm: pre\-empt what the principal needs before each meeting, prepare the day's brief, and close the loop on every open action.
* **HQ anchor:** 
 Act as the HQ anchor while the CSMO is in the field: a reliable point of contact who keeps the office moving, escalates only what matters, and never lets a commitment slip.



**B. Communication \& Gatekeeping** 



* **First point of contact:** 
 Serve as the first point of contact for the office, screening calls, mail and requests with tact, filtering noise, and routing the right matters to the right people.
* **Correspondence:** 
 Draft, edit and dispatch correspondence, notes and communications on the CSMO's behalf in a crisp, professional voice.
* **Representation:** 
 Represent the office of the President with warmth and poise to internal teams, channel partners and senior external stakeholders.



**C. Data, MIS \& Digital Enablement** 



* **MIS consolidation:** 
 Consolidate KRO / Sales\-MIS streams from HODs into clean, single\-source dashboards and review packs, and flag exceptions before they are asked for.
* **Analytics partnership:** 
 Work hand\-in\-glove with the DGM\-level Sales \& Marketing Analytics / MIS SPOC to keep the CSMO decision\-ready while he travels, acting as a data\-fluent proxy for routine review of numbers.
* **Excel \& PPT:** 
 Build and maintain advanced Excel models (pivots, lookups, dynamic dashboards) and craft board\- and review\-grade PowerPoint decks that tell the story at a glance.
* **Digital tools:** 
 Champion the digital toolkit of a digital\-rich organisation (collaboration, task\-tracking, CRM/DMS and reporting platforms) and keep the office's workflows paperless and audit\-ready.



**D. Travel, Field\-Ops \& Meeting Coordination** 



* **Travel:** 
 Plan and orchestrate extensive domestic (and occasional international) travel, covering itineraries, logistics, market visits and dealer meets, with contingency built in.
* **Governance:** 
 Coordinate reviews, town halls and leadership meetings: agendas, pre\-reads, minutes, and rigorous action\-tracking to closure.
* **Administration:** 
 Manage expense reporting, approvals and documentation accurately and on time.



**E. Confidentiality \& Trust** 



* **Discretion:** 
 Handle sensitive commercial, strategic and people\-related information with absolute discretion. This role sees everything, and is trusted to hold it.



  





**3\. Must\-Have Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 12 years of Executive Assistant experience supporting a Director / CXO / business\-head, of which a substantial part in a large manufacturing organization.
* **Education:** 
 Graduate (any discipline); a business, commerce or secretarial\-practice qualification is an advantage.
* **Context fit:** 
 Proven track record of running a high\-tempo executive office where the principal travels heavily and the EA holds the fort.
* **Domain:** 
 Comfort with the vocabulary and rhythm of sales, distribution, dealers and MIS in a manufacturing/building\-materials setting.



  





**4\. Technical \& Digital Proficiency** 




 Skill on the tools is a threshold, not a bonus. The right candidate is genuinely strong here:
 



**Skill Area Expectation** 




  





**Microsoft Excel** 




 Advanced: pivots, complex formulas, lookups, dynamic dashboards, data clean\-up (must\-have)
 



**Microsoft PowerPoint** 




 Advanced: builds review\- and board\-grade decks independently, clean visual storytelling (must\-have)
 



**MS Word \& Outlook** 




 Expert: formatting, mail\-merge, calendar \& inbox mastery
 



**Collaboration \& PM tools** 




 Fluent in task/project trackers, shared drives, and video\-conferencing platforms
 



**Business systems** 




 Working comfort with CRM / DMS / MIS reporting tools; quick to learn new platforms
 



**AI \& productivity tools** 




 Willing and able to use modern AI assistants to draft, summaries and speed up the office
 



  





**5\. Competencies \& Cultural Fit** 




 This office runs on a specific temperament: humility paired with task\-mastery. Humble in manner, relentless on execution, calm at pace. The EA must mirror that.
 


* **Humility:** 
 Humble and grounded, leads with courtesy and service, ego\-free, treats every colleague and partner with respect.
* **Task\-mastery:** 
 Owns outcomes, not just tasks; follows through to closure without being chased. Nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Proactiveness \& pace:** 
 Anticipates needs a step ahead, brings solutions rather than problems, and moves quickly without dropping quality.
* **Communication:** 
 An outstanding communicator: clear, warm and precise in speech and writing, across every level from shop\-floor to boardroom.
* **Composure:** 
 Unflappable under pressure, adaptable, and dependable in ambiguity.
* **Trust:** 
 Absolute integrity and confidentiality, the office's most trusted keeper of information.



  





 Salary
 



 As per the Industry Standard.

title: Blender 3D Generalist
description:
**We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest\-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.** 




**We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.** 




  





**🎬 Role Description** 




  





**Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.** 




**You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, with a lead who reviews your work.** 




  





**📅 A typical week** 




  




* One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
* You animate. Layout, body, expressions, camera.
* Your lead reviews before you start lighting. Notes come back the same day.
* You do the lighting and either render yourself or give us your file and we render for you.
* You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never just keep waiting for a review.



  





**🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work** 




  




* Render farm access. Your laptop/PC is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
* NO Lip syncing req to be done from your end. we take care of it.
* A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
* An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
* Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
* A named lead who reviews your work and gives you go ahead.
* A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.



  





**💰 Compensation and how you grow here:** 




  





**We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.** 




  





**Tier 3 — ₹5,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.** 




  





**Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000\. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1\.** 




  





**Tier 1 — ₹7,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹70,000–₹84,000\. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000\. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.** 




  





**Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.** 




  





**Two things worth saying plainly.** 




  





**None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.** 




  





**Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.** 




  





**Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.** 




  





**✅ Qualifications** 




  





**You need to be strong in Blender at:** 



* Layout and scene setup
* Character animation — body mechanics, facial expressions.
* Camera animation
* Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable
* lighting and rendering.



  





**And you need to be someone who:** 



* Can own a full video without being chased
* Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly
* Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.
* lighting and rendering.



  





 We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.
 



  





 ▶️ The work we make
 



  




* https://youtu.be/YFcFDlAsSO4
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF\-mI
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb\-qOTao



 Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.
 



  





 📩 How to apply
 


* Fill the form: https://join.thefutureanimations.com/apply

title: Video Editor
description:
**Role Description** 




 iLEAD Kolkata is looking for a
 **full\-time Social Media Video Editor** 
 who understands how to edit for attention, retention, and platform\-native storytelling.
 



 This role is for someone who is creatively sharp, visually curious, and technically strong, with a strong instinct for
 **Instagram Reels, Facebook content, short\-form videos, digital promos, event content, and campaign\-driven social edits** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who does more than just “follow the brief.”
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to take raw footage, understand the intent, and build a strong fine cut using
 **their own creative judgement** 
 . Someone who knows when to cut faster, when to hold a moment, when motion graphics will elevate an edit, and when they will simply get in the way.
 



 A strong understanding of
 **Instagram\-native editing, current trends, pacing, hooks, transitions, motion graphics, sound design, and visual retention** 
 is essential.
 



 The editor should be confident using
 **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 , and should also have a working understanding of
 **AI tools** 
 that can support editing, ideation, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, and workflow efficiency.
 



 And yes, creativity matters.
 



 But so does accountability.
 



 We are looking for someone who can experiment, think independently, and still
 **deliver quality work on time** 
 .
 



 We’re open to a
 **flexible work setup** 
 , including remote work.
 



 What matters to us is simple:
 **good communication, ownership of your edits, and delivering great work on time.** 




 The exact working arrangement can be discussed during the interview based on what works best for the role and the candidate.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Edit
 **high\-quality social media reels** 
 and short\-form videos for digital platforms
* Work on content for
 **Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, campaigns, events, and promotional communication**
* Create edits that feel
 **current, platform\-native, visually engaging, and brand relevant**
* Use
 **Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 effectively based on project requirements
* Add
 **motion graphics, text animation, transitions, sound design, and finishing polish** 
 where required
* Understand social media behaviour and edit with a strong focus on
 **hook, pacing, retention, and visual engagement**
* Keep track of
 **current editing trends, Reel formats, visual styles, and internet culture**
* Take ownership of edits and build strong fine cuts without requiring step\-by\-step direction for every decision
* Collaborate with the creative and marketing team to execute content in line with brand and campaign needs
* Use relevant
 **AI tools** 
 to improve editing workflows, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, ideation, and productivity
* Manage multiple projects while maintaining
 **quality, consistency, and turnaround timelines**



  




 Experience
 
**Freshers are welcome to apply.** 




 But there is one condition.
 



 Your portfolio needs to be strong.
 



 We are far more interested in
 **what you can create** 
 than how many years you have been creating it.
 



 If your edits make us stop and think,
 



**“Okay. Who edited THIS?”** 




 we want to see them.
 



 Send us your
 **CV \+ your best editing portfolio/showreel** 
 .
 



 And please do not send every edit you have ever made.
 



**Send us the work you are genuinely proud of.** 




**Location** 




**iLEAD Kolkata** 




  





**To Apply** 




 Please share your
 **CV, portfolio/showreel, and relevant work links** 
 .

title: GDS Cyber - AI Driven IAM - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\- Senior AI Engineer – IAM \& Cybersecurity**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**

* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**

* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.

* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.

**Company Description** 
 Arth Early Learning Spaces is a Reggio inspired preschool founded on the belief that all children are competent, capable, and eager to learn, and that every child deserves the opportunity to experience success in school.
 



  





 Arth was created as a space where learning is joyful and children love to come every day. The school’s name, “arth,” reflects the idea that children have a deep need to make sense of the world around them.
 



  





 Founded by Ankur, an IIT Kharagpur alumnus and former teacher in a reggio\-inspired preschool in New Delhi, Arth’s program is informed by global best practices from educators across the USA, UK, Canada, Japan, and India.  The Classroom Facilitator will create a warm, engaging, and safe learning environment for young children, guiding daily classroom activities that foster curiosity, independence, and social\-emotional growth. This full\-time, on\-site role in the Kolkata metropolitan area involves planning and facilitating age\-appropriate learning experiences, observing children’s interests, and adapting activities to support individual needs. The facilitator will document children’s learning through notes, photos, and displays, communicate regularly with families about their child’s progress, and collaborate with colleagues to refine classroom practices. Daily responsibilities include setting up learning spaces, supporting routines such as arrival, meals, rest, and play, and maintaining a clean, organized classroom. The role also includes participating in team meetings, professional development, and school events to contribute to Arth’s collaborative learning community.
